Separate into 6 containers and evenly distribute bacon, macaroni, and chicken bites.

title: Loaded Potato Nachos and Steak
ingredients: Seasonings: taco, onion powder, salt, pepper
instructions: Cook the Potatoes: dice 900g russet potatoes. Boil for 3-4 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Toss with olive oil spray, salt, and paprika. Air fry at 400°F for 25-30 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Cook the Steak: season 28 oz top sirloin with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Grill or sear in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side or until desired doneness. Rest, then dice.
Sauté the Veggies: in a skillet, sauté 1 sliced red bell pepper and 1 sliced red onion over medium heat until tender and lightly caramelized (about 5-7 minutes).

Make the Nacho Cheese Sauce: blend together 300g nonfat cottage cheese, 80g reduced-fat cheddar, and 1 Kraft cheese packet. Heat gently in a pan on low heat until smooth and creamy. If needed thin out with fat free milk to desired consistency.
Assemble the Bowl: in each of the 5 bowls, add a layer of crispy potatoes, steak cubes, sautéed veggies, and top with warm nacho cheese sauce.

title: Cheese Steak Breakfast Bowls
ingredients: Garlic powder, pepper, salt, paprika, onion powder (to taste)
Chipotle sauce: 300g nonfat Greek yogurt (about 1⅓ cups)
instructions: Air Fry the Potatoes: preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Boil cubed potatoes for 3 minutes, then pat dry. Toss cubed potatoes with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Air fry for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Prepare the Chipotle Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g Greek yogurt, 55g chipotle in adobo, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tsp onion powder. Blend until smooth. Chill until ready to use.

Cook the Steak: season 2 lbs sirloin with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and paprika. Sear on a hot griddle for 3-5 minutes per side, or finish in the air fryer at 400°F for 10 minutes or until internal temp hits 135°F. Rest, then slice thinly.
Griddle the Veggies: dice red and green bell peppers and the onion. Sauté on the griddle with salt, pepper, and onion powder for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Fry the Eggs: in a nonstick pan over medium heat, fry 10 eggs to your preference. Season with salt and pepper.

Assemble the Bowls: layer crispy potatoes, sliced steak, and sautéed veggies in each bowl. Top with 1 fried egg, 1 slice provolone, a sprinkle of reduced-fat mozzarella, and 1 tbsp nacho cheese. Finish with a drizzle of chipotle sauce.

title: Queso Beef and Rice Bowls
ingredients: Taco seasoning (for beef and queso, to taste)
instructions: Cook the Right Rice: prepare 5 servings (5 cups of a rice of your choosing). I used Right Rice, a protein packed rice, but you can use regular brown or white. Just adjust macros accordingly.

Cook the Ground Beef: in a large skillet over medium heat, cook 32 oz lean ground beef until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess fat. Season with taco seasoning to taste and stir in 60g reduced-fat cheddar until melted and incorporated.

Blend the Queso Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g cottage cheese, 1/2 packet Kraft cheese powder, 1-2 tsp taco seasoning, and 40g reduced-fat cheddar. Blend until smooth. Add a splash of water if needed to thin to your desired consistency.
Prep the Veggies: dice 1 large tomato and 1 medium onion. Chop fresh cilantro. Slice lime into wedges for serving.

Assemble the Bowls: in each of 5 meal prep containers, layer Right Rice, taco beef, and queso sauce. Top with diced tomato, onion, a spoonful of guacamole (if using), chopped cilantro, and a lime wedge.

title: Orange Chicken and Chow Mein
ingredients: 25 oz chicken breast, diced (≈6.3 oz per serving)
10 oz Barilla angel hair pasta (≈2.5 oz dry per serving)
3-4 tbsp stevia or monk fruit sweetener
Corn starch slurry (1 tbsp corn starch + splash of water)
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz angel hair pasta for 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Make the Sauce: in a bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp orange zest, juice of 1 medium orange, 100 ml chicken stock, 120 ml soy sauce, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 3 garlic cloves minced, and 3-4 tbsp sweetener, and corn starch slurry. Divide in half: half for orange chicken, half for chow mein.

Cook the Chicken: toss 25 oz diced chicken breast into egg yolk (1 egg) then place in a zip lock bag and toss with 60g of corn starch. Air fry until golden and cooked through (approximately 400 degrees for 20 mins or until internal temp reaches 165 or higher). Add 1/2 sauce into a pan at low heat and toss the chicken.
Cook the Veggies + Noodles: in a large pan or wok, sauté cabbage, carrot, celery, green onions, and garlic until tender. Add cooked noodles and the chow mein sauce. Toss well.
Assemble the Bowls: divide noodles + veggies and orange chicken evenly into 4 bowls. Top with extra green onions or a dash of sesame seeds if desired.

title: Crispy Garlic Lemon Chicken with Mac and Cheese
instructions: Air Fry the Chicken: beat 2 eggs in a bowl. In a separate container, add 35g cornstarch. Slice 32 oz chicken breast into strips, dip each piece in egg wash, then coat in cornstarch. Spray lightly with olive oil and air fry at 400°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz chickpea penne according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Blend Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 120g reduced-fat cheddar, 350g fat-free cottage cheese, 1/4 cup fat-free milk, 1/2 packet cheese powder. Blend until smooth and set aside.

Make the Lemon Garlic Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 1/2 cup soy sauce, 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tsp honey, and juice of 1 lemon. Mix 30g cornstarch with a splash of water to create a slurry, then whisk it into the pan until the sauce thickens.
Coat Chicken in Sauce: toss air-fried chicken in the lemon garlic sauce until evenly coated.
Finish the Mac & Cheese: pour blended cheese sauce into a pan over low heat and stir until smooth and warm. Add cooked pasta and mix well. Season to taste.
Serve: divide evenly into 5 servings. One bowl = flavor, gains, and approval from the gym gods.

title: Queso Chicken and Rice Burritos
instructions: Cook & Shred the Chicken: preheat your air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Toss 32 oz cubed chicken breast with 3 tbsp taco seasoning, 1 tbsp garlic salt, and the zest and juice of 1 lime, and mix well. Place in a single layer and air fry for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temp). Transfer to a food processor and pulse until shredded.

Prepare the Rice: in a saucepan, bring 2 cups chicken broth to a boil. Add 2 cups Minute Rice, 1/2 cup tomato paste, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp onion powder, 1-2 minced garlic cloves, and 2 tbsp chopped white onion. Season with salt and pepper to taste, reduce heat to low, cover, and let sit for 5 minutes or until broth is fully absorbed.

Make the Queso Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 10 tbsp nacho cheese, 1/4 cup chicken broth, 1 cup 2% evaporated milk, 20g reduced-fat cheddar, 1 tbsp chopped jalapeño, and 1 tsp salt. Stir until smooth. Add 40g reduced-fat cream cheese and stir until melted and creamy.
Combine Everything: in a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, cooked rice mixture, and queso sauce. Stir until evenly coated and well mixed.

Build the Burritos: lay out 8 low-carb tortillas. Evenly divide the mixture across each. Top each with 15g reduced-fat cheddar (120g total). Wrap tightly into burritos, and grill, bake, or air fry for a crisp finish.

title: Alfredo Chicken with Wedges
ingredients: 5 slices center-cut bacon (plus 1 extra for topping)
Paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper (to taste)
Salt, pepper, and any other preferred seasonings
instructions: Cook the Chicken (Air Fry or Pan Fry): season 32 oz cubed raw chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Air fry option: preheat to 400°F (190°C), cook for 15-18 minutes, flipping halfway. Pan fry option: sear chicken in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil spray for 7-10 minutes until cooked through and golden brown. While it cooks, crisp 5 slices center-cut bacon. Crumble and set aside.

Prep & Cook the Potato Wedges: wash and cut 3 medium russet potatoes into wedges. Boil wedges for 3 minutes, then drain and pat completely dry with a paper towel — this helps them crisp up. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and seasonings. Air fry at 400°F for 20-25 minutes, shaking halfway, OR bake at 425°F for 25-30 minutes, flipping at 15. For extra crisp, increase oven to 450°F for final 10 minutes.

Make the Alfredo Sauce: in a pan over medium heat, add 1 cup chicken stock and 1 cup 2% evaporated milk. Stir in 40g cream cheese, 120g reduced-fat mozzarella, and 28g Parmesan Reggiano. Stir constantly until fully melted, smooth, and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add Broccoli: stir in 1 cup pre-steamed broccoli, letting it simmer for 2-3 minutes to soak up the sauce. Remove from heat.
Combine Chicken & Sauce: add cooked chicken and 5 slices crumbled bacon to the Alfredo sauce. Toss to fully coat everything.
Serve It Up: plate the chicken Alfredo mix, top with extra 1 slice chopped bacon, and serve with crispy potato wedges on the side. Tastebud domination unlocked.

title: Korean Beef Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 32 oz top sirloin, cooked and shredded
3-4 tbsp sriracha (adjust to your spice level)
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz Banza shells according to package instructions. Drain, rinse, and set aside.
Make the Korean Beef: in a large pan over medium-high heat, add a small amount of oil (optional) and sauté 3-4 cloves minced garlic until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Add 32 oz shredded top sirloin and sear until it begins to brown. (Do it in batches.)
In a small bowl, whisk together 1 cup soy sauce, 1 tbsp Korean BBQ marinade, 3 tbsp zero-cal sweetener, 1 tbsp gochujang, 3-4 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp honey, and 1/2 cup chicken stock.
Pour over the beef, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until thickened. Taste and adjust spice/sweetness if needed.

Make the Mac & Cheese: in a separate pot, combine 1 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup chicken stock over medium heat. Stir in 50g reduced-fat cream cheese until melted. Gradually add 150g shredded cheddar, stirring constantly until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Add the cooked pasta and stir until fully coated. If sauce thickens too much, loosen with a splash of milk or broth.
Serve It Up: plate a scoop of creamy mac & cheese and top with a generous portion of the spicy Korean beef. Garnish with sesame seeds or green onion if you're feeling fancy.

title: Buffalo Creamy Chicken Pasta
ingredients: Garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika (to taste)
1 cup Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce
instructions: Cook the Bacon: in a large pan, cook 7 slices of center-cut bacon until crispy. Set aside and crumble once cooled. Leave a small amount of bacon grease in the pan for flavor.

Cook the Chicken: season 32 oz chicken breast with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and paprika. Grill or sear on a griddle over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through (internal 165 or higher). Chop into bite-sized pieces.
Boil the Pasta: cook 11.5 oz Barilla Protein+ pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.

Make the Creamy Buffalo Sauce: in the bacon pan, add 1 cup Frank's Buffalo Sauce, 2 cups fat-free evaporated milk, and 1.5 cups chicken broth. Bring to a simmer. Stir in 50g reduced-fat cream cheese until melted and slightly thickened (about 5 minutes).
Add the Cheese: stir in 200g reduced-fat cheddar and continue stirring until the sauce is fully smooth and creamy.
Combine & Finish: add the cooked pasta, chopped chicken, and crumbled bacon into the buffalo sauce (feel free to garnish with blue cheese and adjust macros). Toss well to coat everything evenly.
Serve & Dominate: serve hot, garnish with extra bacon if you're feelin' wild. You can do it. And your taste buds will thank you.

title: Philly Steak Bites and High Protein Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 50 oz top sirloin or lean steak, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt, pepper, garlic powder (to taste, for potatoes)
instructions: Boil the Potatoes: add 4 peeled and cubed potatoes to a pot, cover with water, and add a pinch of salt. Boil for 10-15 minutes until fork-tender.

Cook the Steak Bites: while potatoes boil, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 50 oz cubed top sirloin and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Sauté the Peppers: add cubed red and green bell peppers to the skillet with the steak. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until just tender but still colorful.

Mash the Potatoes: drain the cooked potatoes and return to the pot. Add 1 cup fat-free milk and 1 cup nonfat Greek yogurt. Mash until smooth and creamy. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
Melt the Cheese: sprinkle 100g reduced-fat cheddar over the steak and peppers in the skillet. Cover with a lid for 1-2 minutes to melt the cheese over the steak bites.
Serve & Finish: plate a scoop of mashed potatoes. Top with cheesy steak and peppers. Finish with a drizzle of high-protein chipotle sauce for extra kick. (This recipe makes 7 servings.)

title: Ultimate Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Peel and dice 3 large russet potatoes. Spray a large skillet with oil and cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden brown and tender. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste. Remove and set aside.
Cook the Bacon & Sausage: in the same skillet, cook 8 slices of center-cut bacon until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Next, add 8 chicken sausage links and cook until browned and cooked through. Slice into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Sauté the Veggies: dice 1 onion and 1 bell pepper, then add to the skillet. Sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened.

Combine Everything: return the cooked potatoes, sliced chicken sausage, 18 slices Canadian bacon (chopped), and crumbled bacon to the skillet with the veggies. Stir well and cook together for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Pour in 700g egg whites. Season again with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Stir gently and cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, until fully scrambled and set.
Sprinkle over 75g reduced-fat cheddar cheese and drizzle with 6 tbsp nacho cheese. Stir everything together and cook for 1-2 more minutes until melted and combined.

title: Hot Honey Sweet Potato Taco Bowls
instructions: Cook the Sweet Potatoes: peel and cube 900g sweet potatoes. Boil in salted water for about 10 minutes until soft. Drain and transfer to an air fryer. Air fry at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy. Season with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, and 1 tsp paprika.
Cook the Ground Beef: add 21 oz 93/7 ground beef to a skillet over medium heat. Stir in 1 packet taco seasoning (add water if packet directs). Cook until beef is browned and fully seasoned.

Make the Egg Muffins: preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spray a muffin tin. Pour 200g egg whites evenly into the cups. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until set. Top each muffin with 1 tbsp (about 30g total) fat-free cottage cheese and 5g reduced-fat cheddar cheese (total 20g cheese). Return to oven for 2-3 minutes to melt.
Make the Hot Honey Sauce: in a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp honey with hot sauce to taste.

Assemble the Bowls: in each bowl, layer crispy sweet potatoes, seasoned ground beef, and 1-2 egg muffins. Drizzle with hot honey sauce. Sprinkle with additional salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika to taste.
Serve hot while the muffins are warm and potatoes are crispy.

title: Cheddar Bacon Broccoli Alfredo
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 8 oz Banza chickpea pasta in salted water for 7-9 minutes, until al dente. Drain, reserve a bit of pasta water, and set aside.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place 8 slices center-cut bacon on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes until crispy. Drain, crumble or chop, and set aside.

Brown the Beef: in a skillet over medium-high heat, cook 16 oz 95/5 lean ground beef for 6-8 minutes until fully browned. Season with 1/2 tsp paprika, salt, and pepper. Drain excess fat and set aside.
Steam the Broccoli: lightly steam or blanch 1 cup broccoli florets until just tender. Set aside.

Make the Alfredo Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 100ml evaporated milk, 1/2 cup chicken bone broth, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, and 1 tsp Italian seasoning. Slowly whisk in 50g reduced-fat cheddar and 70g reduced-fat mozzarella until smooth and creamy.
Combine Everything: in the same saucepan, toss together the cooked pasta, ground beef, crumbled bacon, and steamed broccoli with the Alfredo sauce. Stir well to coat.

title: Greek Chicken Lemon Alfredo
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast (sliced or pounded evenly)
instructions: Season the Chicken: pat 2 lbs of chicken breast dry with paper towels. Season both sides generously with garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper.

Cook the Pasta: bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 10 oz of Decocco fettuccine and cook according to package instructions until al dente, about 7-9 minutes. Drain the pasta and set it aside.

Pan-Fry the Chicken: heat a stainless steel pan over medium heat and lightly coat it with cooking spray or olive oil. Add the seasoned chicken and sear for 5-6 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest for a few minutes, then slice into strips.

Blend the Alfredo Sauce: in a blender, combine 200g of fat-free cottage cheese, 2 garlic cloves, 1/4 cup of 2% evaporated milk, 70g of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 28g of parmesan cheese, and 3 tablespoons of Alfredo seasoning mix. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Warm the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a saucepan and place over low to medium heat. Stir frequently for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce is warmed through and slightly thickened. Adjust seasoning to taste if needed.

Assemble the Dish: toss the cooked fettuccine with the warm Alfredo sauce until well coated. Divide into bowls, top with sliced chicken, and garnish with fresh parsley or lemon zest if desired. Serve warm.

title: Cheddar Bacon Cajun Alfredo
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Sear the Steak & Bacon: cube 25 oz of sirloin steak and sear it in a hot stainless steel pan sprayed with avocado oil over high heat. Cook for about 4-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the steak is browned and crispy. Chop 5 slices of center-cut bacon and add them to the pan with the steak. Cook until the bacon is crispy, then remove both from the pan and set aside.
Cook the Pasta: bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 9 oz of DeCecco cavatappi pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente, usually 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Blend the Sauce: in a blender, combine 250g (1 cup) of fat-free cottage cheese, 70g (2.5 oz) of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 28g (1 oz) of parmesan cheese, 28g (1 oz) of reduced-fat cheddar, 1 garlic clove, 1/4 cup of 2% evaporated milk, 1/2 cup of chicken broth, 1 tsp of Cajun seasoning, and 3 tbsp of dry Alfredo seasoning mix. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Heat the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a nonstick pan and warm it over medium-low heat. Stir gently for about 5 minutes, or until the sauce is fully heated and slightly thickened. Avoid boiling the sauce to prevent curdling.

Combine & Finish: add the cooked pasta, seared steak, crispy bacon, and 1 cup steamed broccoli to the warm sauce. Toss everything together until evenly coated. Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed. Serve hot.

title: Green Chile Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 32 oz chicken breast, cooked and shredded
6 Mission Carb Balance whole wheat tortillas (110 cal each)
Optional seasonings: garlic powder, cumin, salt, smoked paprika, black pepper
instructions: Cook & Shred the Chicken: season 32 oz of chicken breast with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Grill or pan-sear the chicken over medium-high heat until cooked through, then shred it using two forks or a stand mixer.

Blend the Creamy Sauce: in a blender, combine 90g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 250g of nonfat cottage cheese, 4 tbsp (about half) of the Hatch green chiles, a pinch of salt, and a sprinkle of cumin. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Make the Cheesy Chicken Filling: in a large skillet over medium heat, combine the shredded chicken, the creamy blended sauce, 160g of shredded reduced-fat cheddar, and the remaining 4 tbsp of green chiles. Stir until the mixture is fully heated, cheesy, and melty.

Build the Burritos: warm 6 Mission Carb Balance tortillas slightly in a microwave or skillet. Spoon an equal portion of the cheesy chicken mixture into each tortilla, then top each with 1 slice of thin sharp cheddar.

Roll & Sear: roll each tortilla tightly into a burrito. Place seam-side down in a hot skillet sprayed with oil or in an air fryer at 400°F. Sear for 2-3 minutes per side (or air fry for 5-6 minutes), until golden and crispy on the outside.
Serve & Flex: slice, serve hot, and enjoy. These burritos store great for meal prep and taste even better the next day.

title: Tuscan Chicken and Creamy Rice
ingredients: 32 oz chicken breast, raw and skinless
instructions: Grill the Chicken: season 32 oz of raw chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and 1 tsp of smoked paprika. Grill the chicken until fully cooked and nicely charred on both sides. Once done, dice the grilled chicken into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Cook the Rice: prepare 3 cups of Minute Rice according to package instructions. Fluff with a fork and set aside while you make the sauce.

Blend the Creamy Sauce: in a blender, combine 70g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 250g of fat-free cottage cheese, 1/4 cup of evaporated 2% milk, 1/2 cup of chicken broth, 1 tbsp of Italian seasoning, 1 clove of garlic, and 1/2 packet of Kraft mac & cheese powder. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Simmer the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in 28g of parmesan cheese and 56g of reduced-fat cheddar. Continue stirring until the cheeses melt and the sauce becomes creamy and well combined.

Combine Everything: to the skillet, add the diced grilled chicken, 3 cups of cooked rice, 40g of chopped sun-dried tomatoes, 1 cup of fresh spinach, and the remaining 3 cloves of minced garlic. Stir everything together until fully coated in the sauce. Let it simmer for 3-5 minutes to let the flavors combine and the spinach wilt.
Taste & Plate: adjust with salt and additional pepper to taste. Spoon the creamy Tuscan rice mixture into bowls and, if desired, top with a sprinkle of extra parmesan.

title: Honey Chipotle Chicken Nacho Potato Bowls
ingredients: Homemade taco seasoning (for chicken): 1 tsp paprika
instructions: Boil & Air Fry the Potatoes: dice 1200g of baking potatoes into bite-sized chunks. Boil in salted water for 3 minutes to par-cook, then drain and pat them dry. Season with salt, pepper, and a little garlic powder if desired. Lightly spray with cooking oil, then air fry at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy and golden brown.

Season & Cook the Chicken: coat 32 oz of raw chicken breast with the homemade taco seasoning blend: 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp oregano, and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat until fully cooked through and nicely browned, about 5-6 minutes per side. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes, then slice.

Make the Honey Chipotle Sauce: in a blender, combine 7 chipotle peppers in adobo with 2 tbsp of honey and 1/2 cup of chicken broth. Blend until smooth, then pour into a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened.

Blend the Nacho Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 60g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 1/2 cup of evaporated 2% milk, 120g of reduced-fat cheddar, and 1/2 pouch of Kraft cheese powder. Blend until fully smooth. Pour the mixture into a saucepan and warm gently over low heat, stirring until melted and pourable.

Assemble the Bowl: in each serving bowl, start with a layer of crispy air-fried potatoes. Add sliced taco-seasoned chicken breast, drizzle generously with the honey chipotle sauce, and pour on the creamy nacho cheese.

title: Southwest Queso Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: Seasonings: chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt
Garlic powder & smoked paprika, to taste
instructions: Cook the Rice: start by cooking 3 cups dry white minute rice according to package instructions. Once cooked, set aside and keep warm.

Make the Queso Rice Base: to the hot rice, stir in 300g of nonfat cottage cheese, 60g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 80g of shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese, 4 tsp of Kraft cheese powder, and 2 tbsp of Knorr Alfredo mix. Stir everything together until the rice becomes creamy and cheesy. Set aside.

Grill the Chicken: season 32 oz of raw chicken breast with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat until fully cooked and lightly charred. Once done, chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss into the queso rice mixture.
Add the Mix-Ins: stir 1/2 cup of black beans into the chicken and rice mixture. If using, add 1 cup of corn. Mix everything together in the same pan or bowl until evenly combined.

Make the Chipotle Yogurt Drizzle: in a small bowl, mix 3 tbsp of Greek yogurt with 1 tsp of chipotle in adobo, 1-2 tsp of lime juice, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and a splash of water to thin it out. Stir until smooth and creamy.

Assemble the Bowls: spoon the creamy queso chicken rice mixture into 6 meal prep containers or bowls. Top each with 1/6 of a sliced avocado and drizzle with the chipotle yogurt sauce just before serving.

title: S.O.B. Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 Carb Balance tortilla (or the lowest calorie you can find)
instructions: Throw your 70g of turkey chorizo (or turkey sausage) on a pan with nonstick spray at medium heat.
Chop up the meat as you go and cook until it's all the way cooked through (approximately 10–12 minutes).
Cook 2 slices of turkey bacon on a pan with nonstick cooking spray or throw in the air fryer until desired crispiness.
Throw 150 grams of egg whites into a pan with salt and pepper and cook all the way through.
While the eggs are cooking, add your fat-free cheese.
Throw 2-4 tots in the air fryer at 400 degrees and cook until desired crispiness, along with bell peppers and fresh jalapenos (sliced).
Put it all together.

title: Breakfast Bagel Club
ingredients: 1 low cal bagel or english muffin
instructions: Measure 150g of egg white and add it to a nonstick pan with salt and pepper, medium heat until fully cooked.
Add 28g of fat-free cheese to your eggs while they are cooking.
Throw your turkey bacon and Canadian bacon in the air fryer or a nonstick pan (10 minutes in the air fryer or until desired crispiness).
Toast your thin bagel to desired "toastiness."
Add spray butter to your bagel.
Toss a slice of Velveeta on your bagel and add all of the contents.

title: Hungry Man Waffle Plate
ingredients: spray butter (optional) or low cal butter
instructions: Add 92 grams of egg whites to a mixing bowl.
Add 53 g of Kodiak waffle mix.
Add almond milk and stir until the desired consistency is reached.
Either make pancakes and put the desired amount of mix into a nonstick pan or a pan with nonstick spray on medium heat, flipping when ready. (If you have a waffle maker, definitely use that.)
Cook 2 turkey sausage patties in the air fryer or on a nonstick pan.
Add spray butter to your cakes along with the sugar-free syrup.
macroNote: Pro tip from the author: if you have a waffle iron, use it; otherwise make pancakes on a pan with nonstick spray. This meal is filling — make enough for the week to stay on track.

title: Kyle's Turkey Bacon Club
instructions: Take the desired amount of Greek yogurt and add ranch seasoning for the sauce. (Light mayo and mustard are also fine.)
Place two slices of turkey bacon on the stove or in the air fryer.
Cook to the desired crispiness.
Piece together all of the ingredients in a wrap or low cal bread slices.
macroNote: Pro tips: add pepperoncini, pickles, veggies and lettuce (watch your calories) — jalapenos are a favorite add-in. Always warm your tortilla before rolling to avoid splits. Make sure it fits your macros!

title: Flat Bread Garlic Chicken Pizza
instructions: Dice up the chicken tenders to your desired size (the smaller, the better).
Add garlic, salt, and pepper seasoning to the chicken and throw it in the air fryer until cooked all the way through.
Place 28g of pizza sauce on your low-cal flatbread. Sprinkle garlic into the sauce.
Mix in 28–56 grams of fat-free mozzarella cheese.
Add your diced chicken and 28 grams of turkey pepperoni.
Add additional veggies of your choice — mushrooms and freshly diced jalapeños work well.
Place it all in the oven and cook on a baking sheet or in an air fryer until desired crispiness.
macroNote: Pro tips: find a flatbread under 160 calories; cook at 400°F for 8 minutes, plus 1 extra minute to broil.

title: Taco Tuesdays Taco
ingredients: 3 low cal tortillas (50 cal or less)
instructions: Chop all of your veggies.
Cook your 96/4 beef in a skillet at medium heat until cooked through thoroughly.
Add taco seasoning for added flavor to your beef, as well as 1/2 cup of water (bring to a simmer).
Using a nonstick spray, cook your tortillas until desired warmth or texture.
Make yourself two beautiful, high-protein tacos.
macroNote: Pro tips: always crisp up your carb-balance tortillas on a warm skillet. Add a tablespoon of nonfat Greek yogurt and, if you have room, avocado.

title: AM Meatzilla Burrito
instructions: Measure out 150 grams of egg white into a bowl.
Add salt and pepper to your egg white and stir.
Scramble your egg whites in a pan with some nonstick spray.
Add 28g of fat-free cheddar.
Simultaneously, in the air fryer, throw in your sausage and turkey bacon and cook until desired crispiness.
Warm up or slightly crisp the tortilla before adding all the ingredients.

title: In and Out Style Burger
instructions: Chop up your veggies.
Cook the 4oz. patty on the grill or in the air fryer. Let the air fryer cook at 400 degrees for 10 minutes.
Add a Velveeta slice right before the patty is done.
Toast your bun (use a little spray butter).
Combine 1 tablespoon ketchup, 2 tablespoons light mayo, mustard, 1 tablespoon relish, and a couple of dashes of paprika.
Put your burger together and enjoy.
macroNote: Pro tips: add lettuce, tomatoes, and pickles. Always salt and pepper your patties, and marinate in mustard for that authentic taste.

title: Buffalo J.M. Burger
instructions: Dice your jalapeños and mushrooms and toss in the air fryer until desired crispiness (or use a pan with nonstick spray).
Cook your 6 oz. patty on the grill or for 10 minutes at 400 degrees in the air fryer (internal temperature should reach 150°F).
Toast keto buns in an air fryer with spray butter (or grill).
Combine light mayo and sriracha (or whatever low-cal sauce you want) and spread.
Toss two slices of turkey bacon into an air fryer or nonstick pan.
macroNote: Pro tip: a must eat, and often!

title: Chocolate PB Banana Shake
ingredients: Organic unsweetened vanilla almond milk (1 cup)
instructions: Add 1 cup of ice, 1 cup of almond milk, 1 scoop of protein powder, 1 scoop of PB Fit peanut butter, and 1/3 cup of nonfat plain Greek yogurt to a blender.
Blend until smooth!
macroNote: Pro tip: if you have room in your macros, add an extra scoop of your favorite chocolate protein powder.

title: Turkey Bacon Jalapeno Ranch Pizza
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Use a nonstick spray on an oven tray.
Place your flat bread down.
Add 60g of pizza sauce.
Add 56g of fat-free mozzarella.
Dice up your jalapeños and place them on the pizza.
Dice up 5 slices of turkey bacon and add.
Bake for 10 minutes, and add 1 minute of broiling at the end.
Add 2 tbsp of ranch across the top.
macroNote: Pro tip: because this uses a flatbread and a lot of toppings, it can be a bit flimsy — fold it into a calzone and enjoy!

title: Flat Bread Pepperoni Pizza
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees.
Place 60g of pizza sauce on a low-cal flatbread.
Add 56g of fat-free mozzarella and 56–60 grams of turkey pepperoni.
Bake in the oven for 7–10 minutes.
Broil for 1 minute before taking it out for a nice crisp on the cheese.
macroNote: Pro tips: try adding jalapeños, garlic, olives, and mushrooms. Sprinkle powdered parmesan on top or dip in fat-free ranch if you have the calories left.

title: Classic Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 Mission Carb Balance whole wheat tortilla (71g)
2 slices Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Dice up your two slices of turkey bacon and your turkey patty.
Combine in a skillet over medium heat (use a nonstick spray).
Once the bacon and sausage have a slight crisp on them, add 150g of egg white.
Sprinkle salt and pepper over the top to taste.
Add 56g of fat-free cheddar directly into the skillet.
For the tater tots, cook them following the directions on the package — in an air fryer, cook at 400 degrees for 10 minutes.
Warm the tortilla, and wrap all your contents.
macroNote: Pro tips: add fresh jalapeños and onions, your favorite hot sauce, and a tablespoon of plain nonfat Greek yogurt.

title: Crispy Chicken Zinger Sandwich
instructions: For the zinger sauce, combine 1 tbsp vinegar, sriracha, light mayo, and 15g of ketchup in a bowl and mix.
Roll your chicken tenderloins in your egg white wash, then roll them in your panko (cover completely).
Place chicken tenderloins in an air fryer at 400 degrees for 8 minutes, flip, and cook for an additional 4 minutes. (Make sure they're cooked thoroughly — 165°F or higher.)
Toast your bun, add your sauce, and put it together.

title: Skinny Pizza Bagel
instructions: Set your air fryer or oven to 400 degrees and spread 28g of pizza sauce on your bagel evenly.
Add 28g of turkey pepperoni across both bagel halves.
Add 28g of fat-free mozzarella.
Add 15–30g of fresh jalapeño.
Cook in the air fryer or oven for about 8–10 minutes (check on it often).
macroNote: Pro tips: double the cheese or pepperoni for more protein — watch out, this one is addictive.

title: Bacon Wrapped Mandate Dog
ingredients: 2 slices Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Set your air fryer or oven to 400 degrees.
Wrap your high-protein chicken sausage with two slices of turkey bacon (use a toothpick) and toss in the oven or air fryer for approximately 10 minutes.
While that dog is cooking, throw 1/4 cup of your nacho cheese in a saucepan, add salt, pepper, and a tablespoon of barbecue sauce, and stir for a few minutes on medium heat.
Slice your jalapeño and green onions.
Toast your low-calorie hot dog bun for a few minutes in the oven.
Assemble your dog.
macroNote: Pro tip: for extra protein, cook up some well-seasoned ground turkey and, once fully cooked, throw it in with your nacho cheese (70g for an extra 10g of protein).

title: Game Day Buffalo Nuggets/Quesadilla
ingredients: 8 lightly breaded chicken nuggets (Kirkland or Real Good Foods)
Frank's RedHot buffalo sauce (as much as you need)
instructions: Preheat your oven or air fryer to 400 degrees.
Use macro-friendly panko chicken nuggets (8).
Toss the nuggets into your oven or air fryer and cook for about 4 minutes.
In a separate dish, mix 1 tablespoon of fat-free ranch and low-cal buffalo sauce.
Take your nuggets out and saturate them in your buffalo ranch sauce.
Put them back in your oven or air fryer for 3–4 more minutes.
Take your tortilla and add 28g of cheese and jalapeños; place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 4-5 minutes.
Add a tablespoon of G. Hughes barbecue sauce for dipping.
macroNote: Pro tip: a classic snack for football Sunday!

title: Chicken Bacon Gameday Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 slice Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Preheat your oven or air fryer to 400 degrees.
Place your turkey bacon, 3 slices of Canadian bacon, and nuggets into the oven or air fryer on a baking sheet (nonstick spray if using the oven).
Cook until slightly crispy (typically 5–7 minutes).
In a separate bowl, measure out approximately 70 grams of plain, nonfat Greek yogurt.
Add your ranch seasoning packet to the yogurt and mix thoroughly.
Add ingredients to a low-cal tortilla.
Add your cheese and roll it up.
Place in the oven or air fryer for another 4 minutes. Enjoy!
macroNote: Pro tips: for best results use an air fryer; you can also cook the bacon/Canadian bacon on a pan at medium heat with nonstick spray.

title: Chicken Alfredo Garlic Fries
ingredients: 84g Alexia House Cut Fries with Sea Salt
instructions: Preheat your oven or air fryer to 400 degrees.
Dice up a 4oz. chicken breast into 6 thin pieces; season with salt, pepper, and garlic salt (your favorite seasonings).
Put in the air fryer for 8 minutes (until cooked all the way through).
Place the fries in the air fryer, seasoned, for 4 minutes at 400 degrees.
Take the fries out and mix in parsley and garlic.
Throw the fries back in the air fryer for 4 more minutes (or until crispy).
Place one serving of Alfredo sauce in a nonstick pan over medium heat on the stove.
Add 28 grams of fat-free cheddar and stir until melted.
Plate your fries and chicken.
Add the cheese on top.
macroNote: Pro tip: if you have room in your macros, add a tablespoon of olive oil to your fries before the second air fry.

title: The Chillest Chili
ingredients: 3 containers (130g each) Great Value organic tri-color beans, canned
165g Hunt's Tomato Paste with Basil, Garlic, and Oregano
instructions: Dice onions and fresh jalapeño.
In a large pan, use nonstick spray; sauté onions and diced jalapeño.
Once they are cooked down, add your 17 oz. of 93/7 beef to the pan.
In a separate bowl, mix your seasonings together and add a couple of tablespoons of water.
Pour your seasonings into the pan (to taste).
Cook your beef thoroughly while chopping it up.
Add your tomato paste and 3 cans of tri-color beans.
Add approximately 1 cup of beef stock or water; mix all ingredients together.
Cover and let cook on medium for 1–3 hours.
Depending on your macronutrient requirements, serve 1 cup or 2 cups.
Garnish the top with fresh jalapeño, onions, fat-free cheese, and Greek yogurt.
macroNote: Pro tip: for tracking a big batch like this, log all ingredients in MyFitnessPal, save as a meal, and set the serving to 1/15 of the batch for one cup (1/30 for two cups, etc).

title: EZ Buffalo Dip Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat the air fryer or oven to 400 degrees.
In an oven-safe dish, add the entire can of canned chicken breast.
Add 2 tablespoons of nonfat Greek yogurt.
Add 3–4 tbsp. of Frank's Buffalo sauce.
Add the fat-free mozzarella and 2 tablespoons of blue cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes or until the edges get crisp.
Toast your buns; make 2 sandwiches.

title: Kyle's BIG "M" Burger
ingredients: diced onions, pickles, lettuce, and tomato
instructions: Preheat an air fryer or grill to 400 degrees.
Make two 3.5-ounce patties out of your 7 ounces of beef.
If using the air fryer, 10 minutes at 400 typically does the trick — make sure the patties cook thoroughly.
In a separate bowl, combine chopped hamburger pickles, 2 tablespoons light mayo, and 1 tablespoon mustard with 1 tablespoon white vinegar for the mac sauce.
Toast your buns in the air fryer with a couple splashes of spray butter.
Assemble your burger by putting a little sauce on each bun.
Add your lettuce, tomato, and onions.
Add a Velveeta slice or low-calorie cheese towards the last 2-3 minutes of cook time on your patties.
macroNote: Pro tip from the author: this is one of his favorites — take a photo and tag him in it!

title: Skinny Breakfast Skillet
ingredients: 1 slice Velveeta or reduced fat cheddar
instructions: In a nonstick pan, measure out 150 grams of egg whites.
Dice up 3 slices of Canadian bacon.
At medium heat, combine egg whites and Canadian bacon in a skillet.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Toss in 1 slice of your low-fat, low-calorie cheese and add your favorite veggies (or cook your veggies down first).
Finish with nonfat plain Greek yogurt on top and your favorite hot sauce.
macroNote: Pro tip: if you're trying to keep calories low but need a high-volume meal, this is it!

title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 0.5 cup Swanson Beef Cooking Stock (gluten free)
instructions: Bring 3–4 cups of water to a boil, then add your noodles.
Cook for approximately 11 minutes.
Place 20 oz. lean beef in a medium-sized pan and begin to cook thoroughly.
5 minutes into cooking your beef, add onions and mushrooms.
Add seasonings.
Add pasta to the meat and veggies.
Add 3-4 cups of beef broth.
Add a full serving of nonfat Greek yogurt and stir.
Add 1 cup of organic flour.
Add 4 tbsp. of Dijon mustard.
Stir and cook at medium heat for about 10 more minutes.
macroNote: Pro tip: weigh the entire meal in ounces with your digital scale, divide the total ounces by 4 for your serving size — approximately 400 calories and 40-47g protein per serving.

title: Anabolic Greek Gyro
instructions: Toss 5 oz. chopped roast beef into a nonstick skillet at medium heat for 3-6 minutes.
Grate half a cup of cucumber.
Dice up one medium tomato.
Dice up one red onion.
Put 85 grams of your yogurt into a separate bowl and add garlic, seasonings, cucumber, and a splash of lemon. Stir.
Add your tzatziki yogurt sauce to your flatbread.
Assemble the rest of the ingredients and top with feta.
macroNote: Pro tip: splurge on some good roast beef sliced fresh from your local deli.

title: Sheese Steak Sub
instructions: In a nonstick pan, toss your chopped onions in at medium heat.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook down your sliced red and green bell peppers.
Set your oven to 400 degrees.
In a bowl, add 1 tablespoon light mayo, 1 teaspoon minced garlic, salt, and pepper, and stir.
Place the garlic mayo on your hoagie roll and place it in the oven for 4-5 minutes.
Toss your 5oz. of roast beef in with the veggies (once they're cooked down). Cook together for 3–4 minutes.
Place all of your ingredients on your hoagie bun and top with fat-free mozzarella.
Place back in the oven for a few more minutes.
macroNote: Pro tip: cook 4-5 of these at a time for the week's meal prep — wrap in tin foil and refrigerate or freeze.

title: Protein Pizza
instructions: Bring a 12-inch nonstick pan to medium heat (spray with nonstick spray for extra slip).
Place your 28g of turkey pepperoni or Canadian bacon in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Trickle a quarter of your 56 grams of fat-free mozzarella with your meats.
Pour 100g of egg white onto the pan and cook until the liquid on top starts to dissolve.
Spread the 63 grams of pizza sauce evenly over the top.
Place the rest of your fat-free mozzarella on top and cover it with your tortilla.
Place a lid over the top for 1 minute.
Flip your pizza onto a plate and place back in the pan for another minute (until the tortilla starts to get golden brown).
Put it on a plate, dice it, and add a little parmesan on top.
macroNote: Pro tip: great for breakfast, lunch, or dinner — super low calories for how high the protein is. Add your favorite veggies.

title: Lean Machine "TOT"chos
ingredients: 1 tbsp verde sauce (or hot sauce of your choice)
instructions: In a nonstick pan, place 4 oz. of 93/7 beef on medium heat.
Add two tablespoons of your favorite taco seasoning.
Place your meat on the scale after it has been cooked down.
Set your air fryer to 400 degrees and place your 117 grams of tots in for about 6–8 minutes.
Place your tots and beef into a cook-safe pan.
Add all of your cheese and your salsa con queso (nacho cheese).
Place in the oven or air fryer at 400 degrees for a couple of minutes, or broil for 1 minute 30 seconds.
Dish your tots out and add your nonfat Greek yogurt.
For extra flavor, dust your nonfat Greek yogurt with chili powder.
Add your hot sauce and salsa.
macroNote: Pro tip: dress it up with cilantro, olives, or fresh diced jalapeño — multiply the recipe by however many people you're serving.

title: Tasty Shredder Breakfast Quesadilla
ingredients: 150g egg whites (add one whole egg optional)
instructions: Place a nonstick pan on the stove and set it to medium heat.
Cook down 1 serving of your Canadian bacon for desired crispiness.
Add 200g of egg whites.
Wait until the top of the egg white starts to get dry.
Place your fat-free cheese on top and your tortilla over it.
Place your lid on the pan for approximately 1–2 minutes.
Flip your quesadilla using a plate and put it back into the pan for the desired crispiness on the tortilla.
Plate the quesadilla and slice it into triangles.
Add your favorite hot sauce.
macroNote: Pro tips: add jalapeños, green onions, and cilantro. If you have room, 50g of nonfat Greek yogurt makes a great sour cream substitute. Make five for the week and freeze extras for quick breakfasts.

title: High Protein Berry Froyo
ingredients: 200g Oikos Greek Yogurt Triple Zero, vanilla
instructions: Add your 200-gram container of Triple Zero yogurt to your favorite bowl.
Add 63 grams of frozen berries.
Add 1/2 a medium banana, sliced.
Add 2 tablespoons of PB Fit powder.
Crush 1/2 a sheet of graham cracker over the top.
Mix it all together and enjoy!
macroNote: Pro tip: save enough calories for this before bed — it works as a healthy, filling, sweet dessert. Crush the berries or blend everything for a more froyo-like consistency.

title: "Filthy" Cheesesteak Pizza
instructions: Preheat your oven or air fryer to 400 degrees.
Place 50 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt onto your lavish flatbread for the sauce.
Mix your tablespoon of garlic into the yogurt.
Lay down half of your 56-gram block of fat-free mozzarella.
Lay out your 5 oz. chopped roast beef.
Add your bell peppers and onions (pre-sauté or steam them first if you like).
Add on your additional fat-free mozzarella that remains.
Spread your blue cheese crumbles and premium cheddar cheese on top.
Place in the oven for about 4–5 minutes, or until desired crispiness is achieved.
macroNote: Pro tip: no tips needed here — just eat it often, it's that good.

title: The "Beast" Omelette
instructions: Get a nonstick pan and heat the stove to medium heat.
Toss in your 85g of southern-style taters/hash.
Cook these down and cover with a lid for faster, more golden-brown results.
Add your serving of Canadian bacon or ham (pre-chopped).
Cook to the desired crispiness, then put the potato and ham in separate bowls.
Add 200g of egg white to the nonstick pan (reduce to low-medium heat).
Cook until the top of the omelette starts to dry, then add your toppings.
Rinse your fat-free cheddar off in a bowl for better melting results and add to the omelette.
When the omelette is golden brown on the other side, flip it onto a plate carefully.
Add cilantro, green onions, nonfat Greek yogurt, and your salsa.
macroNote: Pro tip: make sure whatever hash browns/potatoes you use are only about 60 calories worth to keep the macros the same — adjust if using a higher-calorie potato.

title: California King Burrito
ingredients: optional: pico de gallo, fresh jalapeño, lime juice, cilantro
instructions: Make some guacamole first: mash 2–3 avocados, add a tbsp cumin, a tsp salt or pepper, and a pinch of lime.
Add cilantro and jalapeño (seeds removed) to the guacamole.
Add a tablespoon or two of pico de gallo (diced tomato and white onion).
In another bowl, take your carne asada and add a carne asada marinade (Tapatio brand works well).
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with lime and cilantro. Marinate for at least 30 minutes (optional).
Cook your carne asada on medium-high heat in a nonstick pan on the stove.
Sear each side for 2–3 minutes (until cooked thoroughly).
Dice your meat into strips or cubes and add a little more salt and lime juice.
Place fries in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 8 minutes (until cooked through), if using.
In a separate bowl, add 40 grams of plain, nonfat Greek yogurt and mix in chili powder.
Plate it all together: guac first, followed by your yogurt, fat-free mozzarella, and steak. Roll it up and cook it in a pan until the tortilla is golden brown.
macroNote: Pro tip: prep the fries first so everything is ready together — multiply the recipe to feed guests.

title: Creamy Turkey Rotini Pasta
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium-sized pan. Salt the water (2 tbsp) and add your rotini pasta. Cook for 7 minutes.
In a nonstick pan, add your turkey sausage. Cook on medium heat until thoroughly cooked through.
In a separate bowl, combine 87g of marinara, 35g of nonfat Greek yogurt, a tbsp of minced garlic, 24g of 1/3-less-fat cream cheese, and 28g of fat-free mozzarella. Blend all the ingredients together.
Once your pasta is cooked, drain it and place it in your serving bowl.
Add the contents of your combined sauce ingredients to the pan you used for the pasta.
Cook on medium and stir until the cream cheese and mozzarella are melted into the sauce.
In your serving bowl, add your cooked turkey sausage, followed by your sauce.
Mix together evenly, and add parsley on top to taste.
macroNote: Pro tip: to make this lower in calories, split it into two smaller meals. You can also substitute ground turkey for ground chicken.

title: Tyson Buffalo Chicken Sammies
instructions: Place your two breasts in your air fryer for 30 minutes total at 400 degrees.
After 15 minutes in the air fryer, flip them.
With 5 minutes left, take the breasts out and saturate them in buffalo sauce, then place back in the air fryer for the additional 5 minutes.
Using a meat thermometer, make sure the internal temperature has reached 165°F or higher.
Toast your keto buns in the toaster or air fryer at 400 degrees for 2 minutes.
Add your cream cheese to the buns.
Add your chicken breasts, slaw, and favorite low-cal veggies.
For extra spice, add some more zero-calorie buffalo sauce.
macroNote: Pro tips: remember these panko-coated breasts are raw and must be cooked all the way through. You may want to use your oven at 450°F to cut down cook time — always verify 165°F or higher.

title: Quest Power Nachos
instructions: Cube 5oz. of chicken breast.
Cook at medium heat in a nonstick pan (use nonstick spray as well).
Add in your favorite taco seasonings (track macros) — chili powder, lime, taco seasoning, cumin, onion powder.
Once the meat is cooked through, turn on the broiler in the oven.
Place your chips in an oven-safe tray.
Add your meat, jalapeños, and fat-free cheese.
Broil for 3 minutes or until the cheese starts to get slightly golden.
Serve with 50 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, green onions, and your favorite hot sauces on top.

title: Not a Chevy Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 1 keto bun or low-calorie bread (50 calories)
instructions: Pour 100 grams of egg white into a skillet.
Cook for approximately 3 minutes on each side, or until the egg is solid and golden brown on each side.
Cook your turkey bacon and sausage in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 8 minutes (flip after 4), or until desired crispiness.
Toast the buns, add a dash of spray butter after toasting, and assemble the sandwich to your liking.
To melt the cheese, place in the microwave for 20 seconds, or cook in the air fryer/oven at 400 for 1-2 minutes.
macroNote: Pro tip: try cooking the whole breakfast in one pan on a mini griddle.

title: D.B.T.R. Chicken Turkey Club
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees and place one Tyson panko-breaded breast in the oven (20 minutes on one side, flip and add 7 minutes). Follow the bag directions to make sure it's cooked thoroughly — use only half a breast on the sandwich.
Slice up your tomato and fresh jalapeño. Place jalapeño in with the chicken and bake for approximately 10 minutes (check often; pull out before the chicken finishes).
Toast your bread with spray butter on a medium heat stove or in the air fryer until desired crispiness.
Add 60g of fat-free mozzarella to one or both sides of the bread and 75g of deli turkey, then microwave to melt or air fry 1-2 minutes at 400.
Sauté minced garlic on a medium heat pan (use nonstick spray to save calories) — take off before the garlic burns.
In a separate bowl, mix cooked, minced garlic with 1 tablespoon of light mayo and 1/2 tablespoon hot mustard for the sauce.
Assemble the sandwich with lettuce, tomato, jalapeños, and sauce on each side. Cut it in half and enjoy.

title: Loaded Enchilada Fries
ingredients: 22.5 pieces Great Value regular cut fries
instructions: Preheat a nonstick pan over medium heat on your stove. Use nonstick spray and add 5oz. of cubed chicken to the pan. Season with your favorite taco seasonings.
Cook until the chicken is at the right temperature and white all the way through.
Measure out 56 grams of fat-free mozzarella, 40 grams of Rico's cheese sauce, and 1/2 cup of red enchilada sauce into separate bowls.
Place 22.5 servings of French fries into the air fryer at 400 degrees for approximately 10 minutes, or to your desired crispiness.
Place your cooked fries on a nonstick baking sheet. Place your chicken, any diced veggies, mozzarella, and enchilada sauce over the top.
Place in the oven and set to broil for 3 minutes or until the desired melt is accomplished.
Top with your favorite hot sauce, cilantro, and 35g of nonfat plain Greek yogurt.

title: Waffle Iron Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Chop 3 slices of turkey bacon into small, quarter-sized pieces.
Dice up your jalapeño and cilantro, and mix them together with some pico de gallo.
Cook your turkey bacon in a nonstick skillet over medium heat with nonstick spray, until desired crispiness.
Pour your measured egg white into a large waffle maker or regular skillet at medium heat.
Add turkey bacon and cook down until the egg white is solidified.
Place 48g of nonfat mozzarella on top and cover with your low-calorie wrap (skillet covered with a lid, or shut the waffle maker lid).
Once the cheese has melted, top it with your favorite hot sauce and vegetables.

title: Low Cal Turkey Panini
instructions: Spray both sides of the bread with spray butter and place the bread on a medium-hot pan.
Add your fat-free mozzarella to one side of the bread and 1 slice of Velveeta to the other side.
To the mozzarella side, add your turkey breast.
Cover with a lid until the cheese is melted.
On a plate, add lettuce, tomato, and southwest mustard to the sandwich (or a low-cal sauce of your choice). Enjoy!

title: Big "MAD" Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 slice Velveeta or reduced fat cheddar
instructions: Measure out 5 oz. of 93/7 beef into a bowl. Combine your favorite seasonings — onion powder, salt, pepper, and garlic salt work well. In a separate pan or air fryer, cook one slice of turkey bacon until it is crisp.

Flatten out your meat into a 1/2-inch patty and place into a medium-sized pan at medium heat with a nonstick spray. Cook at medium heat for 5 minutes, flip for an additional 5 minutes. Using a thermometer, make sure your meat is cooked to 160°F minimum.

Take 56 grams of your fat-free cheddar and rinse it off in a bowl. Once rinsed, place your cheese directly on top of your patty and place your carb-balanced tortilla over the top. Cook until the cheese melts and sticks to the tortilla (about 2 minutes, lowering the heat).
Flip your "pancake" and crisp the outer portion of your tortilla to your liking (careful not to burn it). Plate your quesadilla and cut it in half.
Make your sauce: combine 2 tbsp light mayo with 1 tbsp light ketchup, some cooked minced garlic, parsley, and a teaspoon of white vinegar, and stir.
Place a Velveeta single on top of one cut quesadilla half. Add sauce on top of the cheese slice. Add your veggies (lettuce, onions, or whatever you like). Add the rest of your sauce.
Place your other half of the quesadilla on top and enjoy.

title: Creamy Chicken Bacon Pasta
instructions: Bring water to a boil and boil your protein noodles, 2oz., for 7 minutes.
Heat a pan to medium heat and spray with 0-cal olive oil spray. Add 1 tbsp of minced garlic to the pan and cook it down for 2–3 minutes.
Dice up 3oz. raw chicken breast, place in a separate bowl, and add 1 tablespoon of Hidden Valley seasoning plus salt and pepper to taste.

Add your chicken to the medium-hot pan and cook for 10–12 minutes (until the chicken is cooked thoroughly through), chopping it up into smaller pieces as you go. Once fully cooked, place in a separate bowl.
Cook your turkey bacon in the same pan with nonstick spray until crispy, or place in the air fryer for 6–8 minutes at 400 degrees.

Chop up your turkey bacon and combine in a separate bowl with the cooked chicken, 50 grams of 1/3-less-fat cream cheese, 100ml of almond milk, 56 grams of fat-free cheddar or mozzarella, and 1 tablespoon ranch seasoning. Stir before placing back into the pan. Heat at medium heat with nonstick spray until the cheese begins to melt.
Add your cooked noodles (drained) and combine.
Plate and add some minced parsley and tomatoes over the top.

title: Ohhh So Good Creamy Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: seasonings: black truffle parmesan, salt, pepper, parmesan powder, garlic salt, parsley (fresh)
instructions: Bring about 2–3 cups of water to a boil in a medium-sized pot, add your 2oz. of Barilla protein pasta plus a teaspoon of salt, and boil for 7–8 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Dice the chicken breast into quarter-sized pieces (measure out 4oz. for one serving). Add a tablespoon of parmesan, black truffle parmesan, garlic salt, salt, and pepper to taste. Heat a medium pan to medium-high heat with zero-calorie olive oil spray, add the chicken, and cook thoroughly (approximately 10 minutes), then set aside.

In your cooked chicken bowl, add 28g of fat-free cheese, 60g of nonfat plain Greek yogurt, one serving of low-cal Alfredo sauce, a teaspoon of minced garlic, ranch seasoning or parmesan powder, a hint of lemon, and diced parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Empty contents into a medium-sized pan and cook down until you notice the cheese melting into the sauce.
Add your noodles (drained) to your sauce and chicken in the pan. Blend all contents together thoroughly, then plate and enjoy.
Add parsley and tomatoes to the top for extra enjoyment!

title: Mother Fepping Nuggets
ingredients: 15g Great Value plain panko bread crumbs
1 tsp Hidden Valley ranch seasoning dip mix
seasonings: salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, ranch seasoning
instructions: Combine 15 grams of plain panko bread crumbs in a bowl along with recommended seasonings (1 tbsp paprika, 2 tbsp ranch seasoning, 1 tbsp garlic powder, salt and pepper work well).

In a separate bowl, measure out 8oz. of your ground chicken. Add in approximately 22g of liquid egg white to help bind the meat together, then add 56g of fat-free cheddar (pre-rinsed) as well as your panko seasoning mix. Work all the ingredients together with your hands.

Form silver-dollar-sized nuggets (this recipe makes approximately 8–10). Place them in your air fryer at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, flipping at the 5-minute mark. Once baked, air fry an additional 5 minutes. Use a meat thermometer to make sure they're cooked thoroughly (white throughout).
For your dip, combine chopped green onions with 70 grams of Chobani nonfat plain Greek yogurt. Add 2 tbsp of Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning, or to your liking.

title: Chicken Ranch Pita
ingredients: 2 tbsp (0 cal) Hidden Valley ranch seasoning
instructions: In a bowl, combine 5.2 oz. of pre-grilled and cubed chicken breast (or grill it fresh with salt, pepper, and ranch seasoning).

Add 52 grams of plain, nonfat Greek yogurt to the bowl. Add 2 tbsp of 0-cal Hidden Valley Ranch Seasoning and stir all ingredients thoroughly. For extra flavor, add 2 tbsp of chopped green onions to your chicken mix.
Place ingredients in your pita bread (Lavish brand or other 60-calorie-or-lower bread of your choice).
Spray the pita with butter and place it into your air fryer, wrapped tightly. Air fry at 400 degrees for approximately 4-5 minutes, or until golden brown (check on it periodically — it cooks fast).
Plate and enjoy! Add turkey bacon for extra flavor if you have room in your macros, or buffalo sauce and jalapeños for some spice.

title: Tasty Swole Burrito
ingredients: 1 tbsp nacho cheese (medium salsa con queso)
1 Ole Mexican Foods Xtreme Wellness large wrap
salt, pepper, and chili powder to taste
instructions: For one serving, add 4oz. of 93/7 beef to a nonstick skillet set at medium heat. Add a few tbsp of water and your favorite seasonings — taco seasoning, cumin, salt, pepper, and chili powder work well. Cook thoroughly until all the pink is gone from the beef.
In a bowl, combine 4oz. cooked beef, 28g fat-free cheddar, 43g nonfat Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp nacho cheese, a pinch of salt and pepper, one diced jalapeño, and 1 tbsp chili powder. Mix well.
Pour contents into a nonstick skillet at medium heat, stirring often. Once the cheese melts into the mixture, pour it onto a large Ole Wrap or low-calorie wrap of your choice.
Wrap the tortilla, and either crisp each side in the same nonstick skillet or place it in the air fryer for 3–4 minutes at 400 degrees.
Plate and enjoy — add your favorite salsa or hot sauce.
macroNote: Pro tip: cook extra beef and set it aside for other quick meals.

title: Spicy Viral Cfa Nuggets
ingredients: 8 oz. (113g) Isernio's ground chicken, 96% lean/4% fat
14g Great Value plain panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp G. Hughes sugar-free Thai Chili wing sauce
1 diced fresh jalapeño (seeds out for mild, in for spicy)
20g G. Hughes sugar-free Mango Habanero sauce
seasonings: garlic salt, salt and pepper, paprika
instructions: Measure out 14g of panko bread crumbs into a small bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of paprika, a teaspoon of salt and pepper, and a tbsp of garlic salt. In a separate bowl, place 20 grams of egg white for your egg wash.
Form your ground chicken into equally sized nuggets. Dip them into your egg wash and then into your seasoning/panko bowl.
Once formed and plated, try flattening them as much as possible for a quicker cook time.

Place them in your air fryer at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, flipping after 5 minutes. For a crispier nugget, cook for 12 minutes. Check the internal temperature is a minimum of 165°F (cut one open to double-check).
Dice your green onions and jalapeños — try sautéing the jalapeños during the air fry.
Add 3 tbsp spicy Thai wing sauce and 1 tbsp mango habanero sauce on top of the nuggets.
Mix thoroughly and plate. Serve over a bed of rice if you have the calories, or eat them straight up. Top with green onions and diced jalapeño.

title: Jalapeno Popper Tacos
ingredients: 1 tbsp nacho cheese (medium salsa con queso)
instructions: Scramble two large eggs at medium-high heat in a nonstick skillet. Add salt and pepper to taste.

Combine 4oz. cooked 93/7 beef, 1 tbsp chili powder, 28g fat-free cheddar (or mozzarella), 9g 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 35g nonfat Greek yogurt, 14g reduced-fat Mexican cheese, and the scrambled eggs. Mix it all together, plus your favorite hot sauce.
Pour contents into that same pan at medium heat, stirring often until all of the cheese and creams are melted down.
Pour the taquito filling into three separate Carb Counter tortillas. Add green onions and jalapeños. Roll them up tight and spray with spray butter or zero-cal olive oil.
Place them in an air fryer at 400 degrees for 5–6 minutes.
Plate and enjoy — add more nonfat Greek yogurt combined with chili powder over the top for a sour cream substitute.

title: Arnolds Bicep Burrito
ingredients: 2 Ole Mexican Foods Xtreme Wellness large wraps
30g Signature Kitchens red enchilada sauce, mild
1 oz. whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (1-2 peppers)
instructions: Make the chipotle creamy sauce: place 1-2 whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce in a food processor. Add 100g of nonfat Greek yogurt and 2 tbsp of nonfat sour cream. Add a teaspoon of lime juice and a handful of cilantro. Blend thoroughly.

Measure out 8.4 oz. of chicken breast and dice into small squares. Season with 1 tbsp taco seasoning, a tsp chili flakes, a tsp onion powder, a tsp chili powder, and 1 tsp cumin. Mix together and cook in a pan preheated to medium-high heat with zero-cal nonstick spray, chopping smaller as it cooks. Make sure it's cooked all the way through.
Stagger two Ole wraps across one another. Add 2 tbsp of nacho cheese (about 45 calories worth), 56g fat-free cheddar, and your creamy chipotle sauce. Add lettuce, tomato, and jalapeño.
Roll it up and place it in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 5 minutes.
Plate and enjoy.

title: Nostalgia Pocket (Pizza Pocket)
ingredients: 2 oz. Great Value smoked turkey breast
garlic salt or powdered parmesan for seasoning
instructions: Get the lowest-calorie tortilla you can find (the Ole Extreme Large Wrap at 80 calories works well). Warm it up in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Place 28g of Velveeta shreds on your tortilla.
Follow it up with a half serving of pizza sauce.
Layer on one serving (28g) of turkey pepperoni.
Layer on 2–4 oz. of deli turkey and dust it with your favorite pizza seasonings.
Roll it up and toss it in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 7-8 minutes (until desired crispiness).

title: Bro Back Mountain (Grilled Chicken Sandwich)
instructions: Get 5oz. of lean chicken breast and trim off any additional fat. Weigh out 5oz. post-trimming. Cover with a plastic bag or wrap and tenderize with a rubber mallet until about 1/2 inch thin.
Mix 1 tablespoon light mayo with salt, pepper, garlic salt (to taste), and a pinch of lemon juice. Rub this marinade all over your thinned-out chicken breast.

At medium-high heat, using nonstick spray, cook your chicken breast on a nonstick pan for approximately 4 minutes on each side. With a meat thermometer, make sure the internal temperature has reached 165°F or higher.
In a separate pan or air fryer, cook down jalapeños, white onion, and 2 slices of turkey bacon (or vegetables of your choice).
Toast your low-calorie buns for approximately 2 minutes on the chicken pan after cooking.
Put your sandwich together with your favorite low-cal sauce and additional veggies.

title: Creamy Chipotle Steak Fries
ingredients: 100g Signature Select Classic Shoestring French Fried Potatoes
instructions: Make a batch of the Creamy Chipotle Sauce recipe — make extra and jar it up for other recipes.

Dice up your lean steak into small pieces. Add some adobo sauce, lime juice, and salt and pepper for seasoning and mix it all together in a bowl. Premeasure 4.5 oz. of raw top sirloin before adding the marinade.
Place your meat in a nonstick pan over medium-high heat until cooked through — some pink left in the center keeps it tender. Make sure the internal temperature reaches 140°F or higher.
Air fry one serving of your French fries, following the bag instructions (or add more time for desired crispiness).
Once everything is cooked, add your fries to an oven-safe dish, followed by your steak. Place your low-calorie cheese over the top. Broil in the oven for 2–3 minutes (until cheese melts).
Plate and add your favorite toppings: 40g of creamy chipotle sauce, fresh cilantro, pico de gallo, and hot sauce. Add a tbsp of guacamole if you have the macros.

title: Creamy Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 2 whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Place 1-2 whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce in a food processor.
Add 170 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, a handful of chopped cilantro, 1 tablespoon of lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Add an additional tbsp of adobo sauce for more chipotle flavor. If it's too spicy, add more nonfat Greek yogurt — the lighter the color, the milder the heat; the darker, the hotter.
macroNote: A base sauce used across several recipes in this book — the author notes it goes with almost everything.

title: K.M.W.N.O.O.Y.M. Breakfast Taco
ingredients: 2 slices Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Get your air fryer out and air fry a half serving of regular cut fries, following the bag's directions (about 400 degrees for approximately 8 minutes).
In a nonstick pan, cook your entire tube of Jennie-O turkey chorizo or a lean breakfast meat with equivalent macros (season with taco seasonings if unseasoned).
In your air fryer, cook up 2 slices of turkey bacon — approximately 5 minutes at 400 degrees or longer for desired crispiness.

Cook your 150-gram egg white in a nonstick pan with 0-cal cooking spray if needed. Salt and pepper to taste once fully cooked. Add 28g of fat-free cheese and 28g of Velveeta shreds to the eggs while cooking.
Alternatively, melt your cheese in a nonstick pan, then place your low-cal tortilla on top and cover with a lid at medium heat — flip after 3–4 minutes and crisp up the other side.

Once everything is cooked, assemble the taco: eggs, then breakfast meats, topped with the creamy chipotle sauce recipe (or your low-cal sauce of choice) and favorite hot sauces. Pico de gallo and cilantro are great additions.

title: Chipotle Chicken Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 8g Benita whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
1 Don Lee Farms grilled chicken patty (99g)
instructions: Combine 79 grams of fat-free cottage cheese, 55 grams of Rico's nacho cheese, 2 whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, and a half cup of cilantro in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth and set aside as your spicy mac sauce.
Measure out 2oz. of a low-calorie protein pasta and boil for 7–8 minutes, or until softened to your liking.

Grill 5oz. of chicken breast with your favorite seasonings, or use a Don Lee Farms grilled chicken patty from Costco — microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds, then air fry at 400 degrees for 6 minutes, or until crispy.
Dice up some green onions and cilantro.
Combine pasta and sauce back in the pot you cooked your pasta in and cook at low heat. Add 28g of Velveeta shreds and stir until melted.
Plate and add your chicken, green onions, and cilantro over the top.

title: Arnold's Tricep Burrito
ingredients: 2 Ole Mexican Foods Xtreme Wellness large wrap tortillas
seasonings: taco seasoning, salt and pepper
instructions: Dice up a green and red bell pepper. Sauté with salt and pepper in a nonstick pan with zero-calorie spray on medium heat, or air fry for 7-8 minutes.
Measure out 6oz. of lean ground beef and cook at medium-high heat, adding salt, pepper, and taco seasoning to taste.
Air fry two slices of turkey bacon (aim for around 90 calories or less for two, with about 10g of protein).
Once the beef is cooked, add 150g of the creamy chipotle sauce recipe to the beef and mix together.
Fry up two large Xtreme Wellness wraps in a nonstick pan — don't let them get too crispy or they'll become brittle.

Dish out all your ingredients onto the two overlapping tortillas (cheese down first so it melts easier). Once wrapped, put it in the air fryer at 400 for 7 minutes. Cut in half and split into 2 meals.
Add your favorite hot sauce on top.

title: Pizza Pasta
ingredients: 0.8 cup (dry) Pasta Lensi red lentil fusilli
7g pork panko (Pork Panko Fried Pork Rinds)
instructions: Measure out 2oz. of a low-calorie protein pasta (Banza or any red lentil pasta works well) — one serving.
Follow the package directions for boiling your noodles (typically 2 cups of water plus a tbsp of salt; boil for 7 minutes once boiling).
For the sauce, blend 30g of low-fat or fat-free cottage cheese, 108g of nonfat Greek yogurt, and 36g of Rico's premium cheddar cheese (or any cheese whiz). Season with salt and pepper and blend.
Once the pasta is complete, drain (reserving a few tablespoons of pasta water) and pour back into the original pan with your blended sauce, stirring until all the pasta is covered.
In a separate oven-safe dish, spray some zero-calorie nonstick spray and add your pasta. Top with 28g fat-free cheddar, 7g pork panko, and one serving of turkey pepperoni.
Broil in the oven for approximately 3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the pepperoni is crispy.

title: Cutlers Calves (Breakfast Burrito)
ingredients: 3.5oz. Hillshire Farm oven roasted turkey breast
2 Ole Mexican Foods Xtreme Wellness large wrap tortillas
2 slices Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
3g Benita whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Refer to the Creamy Chipotle Sauce recipe if you'd like to make the sauce for the burrito — make extra and save it in a jar for other meals.

In a nonstick pan or air fryer, cook down 3.5 oz. of deli turkey breast and 2 slices of turkey bacon. In a nonstick pan, use medium heat for approximately 10 minutes, flipping at the halfway mark; in the air fryer, do 400 degrees for 8–10 minutes.
In a bowl, combine 1 medium egg and 200 grams of egg white. Whisk together until the egg white and yolk are evenly combined.
Pour your eggs into a nonstick pan over medium heat, add salt and pepper to taste, and cook down. Add 60g of fat-free cheddar to the eggs and cook until thoroughly cooked.
Fry 2 large Xtreme Wellness tortillas for 1 minute on each side — don't let them get crispy or they'll break when rolling.
Overlap both tortillas and add your contents.
Roll this massive burrito the best you can and place it back in the air fryer for 7 minutes. A few sprays of spray butter give it a nice golden brown crisp on top.

title: Strawberry Milkshake
instructions: Use a high-powered blender for this recipe, starting with about 2 cups of ice.
Blend up the ice first to the consistency of a snow cone.

Add a teaspoon of xanthan gum (needed for the ice-cream-like texture), 100 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, 3 tablespoons of your zero-calorie sweetener, 1 scoop of protein powder, and 4 medium strawberries (or 90g of strawberries). Blend all of it together — you may need to stop and stir, then blend once more.
Test it with the flip test: flip your blended shake upside down over a cup or bowl, and it shouldn't fall out if done right.
Optional: add whipped cream on top and a few slices of strawberry, plus crushed graham crackers.

title: Snoop Dog (Chicken Hot Dog)
instructions: Measure out 4oz. of 96/4 ground chicken. Combine your favorite seasonings — a teaspoon of paprika, salt, pepper, garlic salt, garlic pepper, and onion powder work well.
Place your ground chicken on a sheet of tin foil and roll it into a hot dog shape. Twist both ends tight and place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 15 minutes.
At the 7-minute mark, poke 4 holes with a knife through the tinfoil into each dog and continue cooking.
With a meat thermometer, check the temperature has reached 165°F or higher before removing. Let the dogs cool before removing from the tin foil.
Roll the dog onto a nonstick pan at medium heat and slightly grill the outside to your liking.
Toast your low-calorie hot dog bun in the air fryer at 400 for 3 minutes.
Top with your favorite low-cal toppings — sautéed sundried tomatoes, jalapeños, sauerkraut, and a tbsp of horseradish mustard are all great options.

title: Sonic the Hedgedog (Chicken Chili Dog)
ingredients: 1 slice Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Measure out 4oz. of 96/4 ground chicken. Combine your favorite seasonings — a teaspoon of paprika, salt, pepper, garlic salt, garlic pepper, and onion powder. Also add in 30g of rinsed, fat-free mozzarella.
Place your ground chicken on a sheet of tin foil and roll it into a hot dog shape. Twist both ends tight and place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 15 minutes.
At the 7-minute mark, poke 4 holes with a knife through the tinfoil into each dog and continue cooking.
With a meat thermometer, check the temperature has reached 165°F or higher before removing. Let the dogs cool before removing from the tin foil.
Roll the dog onto a nonstick pan at medium heat and slightly grill the outside to your liking.
Toast your low-calorie hot dog bun in the air fryer at 400 for 3 minutes.
Warm up 50g of canned chili (a no-bean chili keeps calories low). Dice up white onion, a slice of cooked turkey bacon, and 1 tbsp of nacho cheese. Finish with 30g of nonfat Greek yogurt.
macroNote: Macros are listed for one dog, but the author suggests making two.

title: White Hot Ranch Barbacoa Fries
ingredients: 5oz. Del Real Foods barbacoa, seasoned beef and sauce
instructions: Toss 130 grams of seasoned or unseasoned frozen fries into the air fryer — 400 degrees for approximately 12 minutes.

For the barbacoa, precook Del Real Foods brand (from Costco) following the bag directions. Once cooked, drain 5oz. of barbacoa and put it in a pan at medium heat for 3-5 minutes with 2 tablespoons of water.
Add 56g fat-free mozzarella on top of the barbacoa and 14g pepper jack cheese. Put a lid over the top and cook down until melted.
Plate your fries and put your cheesy barbacoa over the top.
To make the sauce, combine 85g nonfat Greek yogurt, 25ml almond milk, 2-3 tbsp Hidden Valley ranch seasoning, and 2 tbsp pickled jalapeños in a blender. Blend and drizzle over the top.
Finish with some fresh cilantro on top and enjoy.

title: Dill Or No Dill Burger
ingredients: 2 slices Sam's Choice turkey bacon, uncured
instructions: Make the jalapeño ranch sauce first: blend 40g nonfat Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp ranch seasoning, 2-3 tbsp pickled jalapeño, salt, pepper, and 15ml almond milk.

Make the fried pickles: get the largest sliced pickles you can find. Use panko (regular or bacon panko) — measure out about 1/2 a serving. Roll your pickles in the panko and place in the oven at 400 degrees for 15 minutes (this recipe calls for 6).
Measure out 7oz. of 93/7 beef and make two even burger patties, as flat as possible. Add salt and pepper to your liking.
Throw the patties in the air fryer for 12 minutes at 400 degrees. At 6 minutes, flip; at 10 minutes, add 2 slices of Velveeta.
Also cook 2 slices of turkey bacon in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 12 minutes (pre-prepping a batch for the week works well).
Air fry keto buns for 2–3 minutes with a couple shots of spray butter.
Make sure your ground beef reaches 165°F inside.
Assemble your burger and top with jalapeño ranch. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Cheesy Barbacoa Burrito
ingredients: 5oz. Del Real Foods barbacoa, seasoned beef and sauce
instructions: Use premade barbacoa — follow the bag instructions from Del Real Foods, or make your own (93/7 beef works for similar macros).
Once the barbacoa is cooked, measure 5oz., drained, and add to a nonstick pan at medium heat.
Add 2 tbsp of adobo sauce to your barbacoa, plus 14g of pepper jack and 56g of fat-free mozzarella. Cover with a lid and cook until the cheese melts.
Heat up a low-calorie wrap. Once heated, place your contents on the tortilla, wrap it up, and place it in the air fryer at 400 for 4 minutes (or brown it back on the pan).
Serve with salsa, cilantro, pico de gallo, and the homemade chipotle sauce.

title: Mac N Cheese Pizza
instructions: Measure out one serving of Banza macaroni elbows (2oz. dry).
Add 2 cups of water to a pot on high heat until it reaches boiling.
Add your noodles and cook until softened, 7-8 minutes, stirring frequently.

In a blender or food processor, add 113 grams of fat-free or reduced-fat cottage cheese, salt, pepper, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, and a half packet of the cheese powder from the Banza box, plus about 3 tbsp of almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Once the noodles are ready, drain and place back into the original pot, reduce heat to low, and stir in the blended cream sauce.
