Place the noodles in an oven-safe dish and add your pizza toppings (turkey pepperoni and mozzarella).
Broil on high for 2–3 minutes until the toppings and cheese melt and have a slight crisp.
Using oven mitts, remove the pan and plate. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Chipotle Chicken Burrito
instructions: Measure out 6oz. raw chicken breast. Dice into quarter-sized cubes and place in a bowl. Season with your favorite Mexican food seasonings — a teaspoon of onion powder, a tablespoon of taco seasoning, a teaspoon of chipotle pepper seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix by hand, adding a teaspoon of lime juice if you have it.
Place the seasoned chicken on a nonstick skillet with nonstick spray over medium-high heat (wait until the pan reaches temperature, 4-5 minutes, before adding the chicken).
Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side until nicely browned and cooked all the way through.
Add 30g of shredded, fat-free cheddar (rinsed) on top of the chicken and cover with a lid until the cheese melts.
Make the creamy chipotle sauce from this cookbook.
Warm up the tortilla, then add 1 tablespoon guacamole, 2 tablespoons creamy chipotle sauce, and your cheesy chipotle chicken. Roll it up and put it back in the pan to brown the outside on each side.
Plate and add pico de gallo and hot sauce on top.

title: Pollo Asado Bravado
instructions: Make the marinade: smoke a poblano pepper at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, or air fry at 400 for 15 minutes. Once soft, cut it open, remove the seeds, and place it in a food processor.

Mix the poblano pepper with 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp salt or pepper, 2 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp Mexican oregano, 4 tbsp cilantro, 1 tbsp chipotle pepper seasoning, 1 tbsp garlic salt, and 2-3 limes squeezed into the marinade.

Measure out desired chicken breast (22 ounces used here) and place in a zip-lock bag with the marinade. For optimum flavor, marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours (or rub the marinade on and cook instantly if short on time).

Cook the chicken in a smoker at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, checking internal temperature and flipping at the halfway point — the chicken needs to reach 165°F or higher. (A frying pan or oven also works.)
Add more cilantro once cooked, along with additional squeezes of lime juice.
Chop it up and put it on a taco, burrito, nachos, or burrito bowl — whatever works for your macros!

title: Animal Fry Meal Prep
instructions: Make the fry sauce: combine 4 tbsp light mayo, 1 tbsp paprika, 3 tbsp sweet relish, 6 tbsp low-cal ketchup, and 2 tbsp white vinegar.
Make the fries: place 340 grams of shoestring fries in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, shaking at the 7-minute mark.
Cook 20oz. of 93/7 beef with salt and pepper to taste, plus a few tablespoons of mustard or dijon mustard. Cook until thoroughly cooked on medium heat in a nonstick pan.
Place the cooked beef off to the side in a separate container.
In the same pan, add 1 large chopped white onion and cook down with a pinch of salt and pepper until softened and grilled through.

Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a baking pan, layer your fries, then the beef, then half your onions, then 4 slices of Velveeta cheese evenly, then the rest of the onions on top. Place in the oven until the cheese melts.
Divide into 4 containers and enjoy all week!
macroNote: Macros listed are for the entire recipe (divide by 4 for a single serving).

title: Brookie Monster
ingredients: 0.5 scoop Six Star Triple Chocolate Whey Protein Powder
10g Great Value unsweetened baking cocoa powder
instructions: In a mixing bowl, puree 1/2 a banana with a fork.
Add 35g of PB Fit powder in a separate bowl and mix with water or almond milk to desired consistency.
Combine your mixed PB Fit powder with the banana in a mixing bowl.
Add 10g unsweetened baking cocoa powder, 20–30ml almond milk, 20g Swerve brown sugar replacement, and 1 egg, and whisk together with a fork. Set this bowl aside.

Create the cookie batter: mash 1/2 a banana in a separate bowl. Add 2 tbsp coconut flour, half a scoop of vanilla whey protein powder, another 35g mixed PB Fit powder, 1 egg, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, and 20g Swerve brown sugar replacement, and mix together.
In a baking pan, pour both batters in at the same time.
Add 30 pieces of semisweet chocolate chips and a pinch of salt.
Place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Rhymes W/Scoreo Shake
ingredients: 1 scoop Legion Whey Protein (honey cereal flavor)
instructions: Blend 1.5 cups of ice in the blender.
Once blended, add 100 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt to the blender.
Add 20g of Swerve brown sugar replacement.
Add 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum.
Add 1 scoop protein powder (vanilla-based flavor of your choice).
Blend together and add almond milk as needed — consistency should be like soft-serve ice cream.
Pour into an appropriate-sized cup.
Add 5 tablespoons of fat-free whipping cream over the top.
Add 2 tablespoons of Oreo cookie pieces.
For chocolate frosting, combine 1 tablespoon cocoa powder, 10 grams stevia, and almond milk slowly, whisking for desired consistency, and pour over top.

title: Beefy Fajita Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 packet cheese powder from the Banza box
instructions: Boil your Banza pasta (1 serving).
Drain your pasta once boiled and save a quarter cup (2 tbsp) of pasta water.
Combine 89 grams of fat-free cottage cheese and half the cheese powder packet from the box to make the sauce. Add 80g of nonfat Greek yogurt, a pinch of salt and pepper, and blend until smooth.
Dice up some green bell pepper and white onion. Sauté at medium heat (or throw in the air fryer at 400 for 10 minutes).
Cook 5oz. (93/7) beef and add your favorite taco seasonings until complete.
In the same pan you cooked your beef, add your pasta, sauce, and veggies, and combine.
Serve it up and enjoy.

title: Carnitas Street Taco Pizza
ingredients: 0.1 cup Great Value Monterey Jack cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees.
Thinly slice one radish and chop up your cilantro and white onion.
On your pizza pan or baking sheet, lay down one large Extreme Wellness wrap. Place 28g of fat-free mozzarella on the tortilla and place an additional large wrap over the top.
Spray 5–6 sprays of butter over the top tortilla, and place 28g fat-free mozzarella and 28g reduced-fat mozzarella on top.
Place 3oz. of cooked carnitas over the cheese on the top tortilla. Place your radish, white onion, and cilantro over the carnitas evenly.
Place in the oven for 6 minutes. Turn on the broiler and broil for 2 minutes until the cheese reaches the desired melting point.
Place your favorite hot sauce over the top and enjoy!

title: Animal Style Burger
instructions: Measure out 4.5 oz. of 93/7 beef and add a teaspoon of salt and a teaspoon of pepper. Mold into a patty — the thinner the better.
In a nonstick skillet over medium heat, place 2 tablespoons of thinly sliced white onion. Cook down until golden brown and caramelized, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook your burger. After 5 minutes on medium heat, flip and continue cooking. Check the internal temperature is 165°F or higher before removing.
In the same pan, spray your keto buns with spray butter and place face down until they reach the desired toastiness (typically 2-3 minutes).
Make the sauce: combine 2 tbsp light mayo, 1 tbsp mustard, 1.5 tbsp relish, 1 tbsp ketchup, and 1 teaspoon white vinegar, and mix.
Put your burger together with all the ingredients — shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and pepperoncinis are great additions.
Enjoy!

title: Blazing Gobbler
ingredients: 2 slices Signature Select uncured turkey bacon
4 oz. Hillshire Farm oven roasted turkey breast
instructions: Slice up your jalapeño and white onion, long and thin. Salt and pepper the veggies.
Place them in a nonstick skillet with nonstick spray or on a griddle at medium heat.
Cook the veggies until they cook down and begin to caramelize.
Add 2 slices of turkey bacon to an air fryer or skillet and cook to desired crispiness.
Add 4oz. deli turkey onto the veggies at medium heat and chop the turkey into smaller pieces with a spatula.
Add 28g of reduced-fat mozzarella and 28g of fat-free cheddar over the chopped turkey and veggies. Mix in 2-3 tablespoons Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce on top.
In a separate skillet or on your griddle, toast your two slices of bread — one plain, one with a slice of Velveeta.
Once the bread reaches the desired toastiness, place your chopped turkey and cheese on one slice of bread and top it with the other piece.
It's a messy one, but it's worth it!

title: Pizza Quesadilla II
ingredients: minced garlic, chili flakes, garlic salt
instructions: In a blender, combine 112g fat free cottage cheese, one serving of low calorie pizza sauce, a tsp of minced garlic, chili flakes, and garlic salt, and blend.
Place your sauce on a carb-balanced tortilla and spread evenly to the ends.
Place 56g of fat-free mozzarella on the inside of the tortilla, along with 5 slices of Canadian bacon and one serving of turkey pepperoni.
Fold the tortilla over in half, spray butter on the top, and sprinkle on 28g of reduced-fat mozzarella.
Place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 8–10 minutes.
Optionally, add more chili flakes or additional pizza sauce.

title: Bacon N Egg Bagel Sandwich
ingredients: 12 slices turkey bacon (or center cut bacon)
instructions: In a donut pan or large muffin tin, spray nonstick spray into the cavities.
Pour 300 grams of egg white evenly into each cavity (50 grams each).
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.
Salt and pepper your eggs, and bake for approximately 12 minutes.
Place 12 slices of turkey bacon into a nonstick pan (or the oven) and cook to desired crispiness.
At the same time, lay out your 6 bagels, hit them with baking spray, and let them toast for 5-7 minutes at 400.
Once everything is cooked, assemble: start with a bagel, add an egg, one slice of Velveeta, and two slices of turkey bacon.
Enjoy!

title: Rooster Eggs (Protein Bites)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 16 oz. of 96/4 ground chicken and season with the listed seasonings. Hand mix together.
Add 4oz. of cubed ham as well as 75g of reduced-fat mozzarella.
Add one cracked egg and mix together. Form 18 individual protein bites by hand and air fry for 20–25 minutes at 400 degrees. Check the internal temperature is above 165 before removing.
Enjoy with your favorite low-cal dip.

title: Creamy Buffalo Grilled Cheese
instructions: Chop up your parsley and chives and set aside (2 tbsp of each).
Measure out 16 ounces of boneless, skinless chicken thighs and mix in all of your seasonings well.
In a nonstick pan at high heat, sear your thighs for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Reduce heat to medium and cook your thighs until they reach an internal temperature of 165°F or higher.
Make the sauce: in a blender, combine 100g reduced-fat mozzarella, 60g 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 1/2 tsp garlic puree (optional), 2 tbsp buffalo sauce, and 25ml almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Once the chicken is cooked, chop into nickel-size pieces and return to your pan at medium heat.
Add your creamy sauce to the chicken, mix well until the cheese melts, and add your chives.
Make 4 grilled cheese sandwiches, evenly portioning the meat across each. Add one slice of provolone to each.

title: Cherry Crumble Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 heaping scoop GNC Total Lean Shake, French Vanilla
instructions: In a blender, combine 100 grams of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 300 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, 1 egg, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, 50 grams of Swerve, and approximately 25ml of almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Pour contents into a nonstick baking pan (a 6-inch springform pan works well), making sure the contents settle evenly.
Bake at 350 for 20–23 minutes. Remove and let cool for 15 minutes before refrigerating for 1-2 hours.
Remove from the fridge and add one serving of cherry pie filling (no sugar added) along with one Graham cracker crushed into a powder.
Cut into 4 easy slices and enjoy!

title: Animal Fry Burrito
ingredients: 5 Ole Mexican Foods Xtreme Wellness large wrap tortillas
90 pieces Signature Select Classic Shoestring French Fried Potatoes
gourmet burger seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder
instructions: Chop 1/2 of a white onion into small cubes and toss in a nonstick skillet at medium heat with zero-calorie nonstick spray. Cook until golden brown and caramelized, then set aside.
Measure out 30 ounces of top round or 93/7 beef and season with gourmet burger seasoning, salt, pepper, and onion powder.
In the same pan, cook your beef thoroughly. Once cooked through, add five slices of Velveeta cheese and cover with a lid to melt.
Add your caramelized onions (heat off) and mix throughout.
Make the sauce: combine all sauce ingredients by hand or in a food processor. Add paprika if you have some.

Get out 5 tortillas, add 1 tbsp of sauce to each, and evenly distribute the meat. Add additional veggies if desired. Fold into a burrito (optionally grill each side in the pan) before storing in the fridge.

title: Creamy Cajun Pasta
ingredients: 4 links Organic Hot Italian chicken sausage
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil with a pinch of salt.
Pour your 8oz. of protein-rich pasta into the pot and cook for approximately 8–9 minutes, per the box directions.
Drain your noodles and reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water for later.
Measure 12 ounces of chicken breast and season with the above seasonings. Cook at medium-high heat in a nonstick skillet until the internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher.
Set your chicken aside and, in the same pan, add 4 sliced chicken sausages. Cook at medium heat until the edges form a slight crust.
For the sauce, blend 1 tablespoon of garlic paste with 200 grams of fat-free cottage cheese, plus 1 tbsp Old Bay and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning.
Add the noodles, cooked chicken, and sauce to the sausage pan at medium heat, along with 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Stir together and dish out into 4 equal-sized containers.
macroNote: Protein figure (12g) is exactly as printed in the source, though it appears understated relative to the chicken and sausage listed.

title: Birthday Cake Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 heaping scoop GNC Total Lean Shake, French Vanilla
2 scoops Meal Boosters unflavored protein powder (optional)
instructions: In a blender, combine 100 grams of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 300 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, 1 egg, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, 50 grams of zero-calorie sweetener, and approximately 25ml almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Pour contents into a nonstick baking pan (a 6-inch springform pan works well, lightly greased), making sure the contents settle evenly.
Bake at 350 for 20–23 minutes. Remove and let cool for 15 minutes before refrigerating for 1-2 hours.
Meanwhile, make the frosting: combine 40 grams of Lakanto 0-cal powdered sugar sweetener with 15ml of almond milk. Stir until you reach the desired consistency.
Pull the cheesecake out and add your frosting as well as 1 tablespoon of low- or no-calorie birthday cake sprinkles.
Cut into 4 slices and enjoy.

title: Pin Wheel Pizza
instructions: Before starting, feel free to dice up your favorite veggies — mushrooms and diced jalapeños work well.

Place half a serving of pizza sauce on one generous piece of bread and spread to the ends. Use 1/4 of all the listed ingredients. Once the toppings are on, roll the wrap tight and cut into 5 even pieces.
Repeat this process one more time and place these pizza wheels in a small baking pan or 6-inch springform pan.
With your leftover toppings, spread them across the tops of all your pizza wheels.
Place in the oven at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Pocket Burrito
ingredients: 2 tbsp fennel, sage, garlic salt, and everything seasoning
instructions: Season 16oz. 94/6 ground chicken with 2 tbsp fennel, sage, garlic salt, and everything seasoning (salt and pepper).
Heat a nonstick pan with zero-calorie nonstick spray at medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then add your chicken.
Break it up into smaller pieces and cook for approximately 10–12 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
In the same pan, add 4oz. of cubed ham (precooked) and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 3 Laughing Cow wedges, 120g pizza sauce, and 120g reduced-fat mozzarella.
Top with 30 slices of turkey pepperoni and cover with a lid. Mix together until all the cheese is melted and combined.
This makes 4 burritos. Take 4 low-calorie tortillas and evenly distribute the toppings. For a finishing touch, grill both sides of each tortilla in the pan.

title: Pretzel Bites with Beer Cheese
ingredients: 1 oz. Firestone Mind Haze Light IPA
instructions: Combine 1 cup of self-rising flour with 150 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt.
Set aside 1/4 cup extra self-rising flour to sprinkle on your work surface.
Combine your ingredients into a ball, then work that ball into a long dough snake.
With a pizza cutter, cut the snake into 1-to-2-inch-long strips.
Place them evenly separated in an air fryer, splash with some spray butter, and cook at 400 degrees for 12 minutes.
For the beer cheese, blend all the beer cheese ingredients, then pour into a nonstick pan at medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the cheese melts.
Eat your desired amount and share with friends.

title: Creamy Chicken Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 16 oz. boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cubed
salt, pepper, garlic salt, onion powder, sage, basil (1 tbsp each)
instructions: Chop your raw, skinless, boneless chicken thighs into quarter-sized pieces and place in a bowl to season.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic salt, onion powder, sage, and basil (1 tbsp each).
Mix the seasonings into the chicken thighs and place in a nonstick skillet at high heat with nonstick spray.
Meanwhile, follow the pasta box directions and boil — approximately 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, make the creamy sauce: blend 60g pesto, 200g fat-free cottage cheese, 1-2 tbsp basil paste, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and 20-30ml almond milk.
Your chicken should cook for approximately 12–14 minutes, until golden brown outside and cooked all the way through (break up with a spatula to check).
Drain your pasta and toss it in with the chicken and sauce. Cook and blend together for 5 minutes and serve for four, or refrigerate for meal prep.

title: Anabolic Orange Chicken
instructions: In a plastic ziplock bag, combine 6oz. diced chicken with 2 tbsp corn starch. Shake the closed bag to coat.

Heat a nonstick skillet to high heat with 0-cal nonstick spray and add your chicken. Cook until golden brown, turning after 5–6 minutes. Make sure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F or higher.
Once the chicken is cooked, add 4 tablespoons of orange-ginger marinade to the pan, as well as chili flakes and garlic.
Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce and chicken are combined.
Serve over 1 cup of white rice and add your favorite garnishes.

title: Creamy Alfredo Meatball Spaghetti
ingredients: salt, pepper, fennel, sage, garlic salt, chopped parsley
0.5 cup roasted garlic Alfredo pasta sauce
instructions: Combine 16 oz. of 96/4 ground chicken in a large bowl with salt, pepper, fennel, sage, garlic salt, and chopped parsley. Mix together and make 20 meatballs of the same size.
Place the meatballs in your air fryer with space between them and cook at 400 for 15 minutes. Check that the internal temperature is 165°F or higher.
For the sauce, combine 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese, 1/2 cup Alfredo sauce, and 1 serving of reduced-fat mozzarella, and blend.
Drain your hearts of palm and boil in water for 4 minutes. Drain again and add the linguine to a nonstick pan at medium heat with nonstick spray.
Add your sauce over the top of the linguine and cook to a simmer.
Add half your meatballs onto half the sauce and pasta and enjoy!
macroNote: This recipe serves two — the calories and protein listed are for half of the entire batch.

title: Poor Boy Mcmuffins
ingredients: 1 tbsp sage, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Use nonstick spray on a muffin tin or baking sheet.
Pour 300 grams of egg white into 6 individual muffin openings evenly.
Add 12.5 grams of reduced-fat cheddar into each opening, on top of the egg white.
Place the muffin tin in the oven and cook for approximately 12–15 minutes.

In a separate bowl, combine the chicken sausage with the seasonings. Make 6 individual patties and cook in a nonstick pan on high heat, about 5 minutes on each side, as thin as possible — check the internal temperature is above 165 before removing.
Toast all of your English muffins, halved, face down on a baking sheet at 350 degrees for 8 minutes.
Once everything is cooked, give each sandwich a patty, a slice of provolone, and an egg puck. Add mashed or sliced avocado on one side if you have the calories to spare.
Enjoy!

title: Arugula Chicken Pesto Mac
ingredients: seasonings: red garlic, salt, pepper, everything seasoning
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil, then boil your protein noodles for 8–10 minutes, or until soft.

Combine 226 grams of fat-free cottage cheese, 40 grams of reduced-fat cream cheese, 1 tablespoon of basil paste, 1/2 cup arugula, and all the seasonings in a blender. Blend, adding almond milk for a lighter consistency, plus 1 tablespoon minced garlic. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine all seasonings onto cubed, diced chicken and work in to distribute evenly.
Cook your chicken on high heat in a nonstick pan with nonstick spray, on both sides until golden brown and thoroughly cooked.

Once your pasta is drained and chicken is cooked, combine the pasta, sauce, 90 grams of fat-free mozzarella, and chicken all together. Add parsley, chili flakes, and parmesan over the top and distribute into 4 equal servings.

title: High Protein Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: seasonings: basil, Italian, salt, pepper, oregano, onion powder
instructions: Add 4-5 cups of water and a pinch of salt to a pot and bring to a boil.
Add your 8oz. of spaghetti/linguine and boil for 7–8 minutes, or until desired softness.
Mix together the seasonings (1 tbsp of each) with 16 ounces of cubed chicken breast.
Get a frying pan up to high heat, hit it with nonstick spray, and cook your chicken golden brown on both sides, all the way through.
In a blender, add your seasonings, 395 grams of fat-free cottage cheese, 112 grams of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, about 30ml of almond milk, and a tbsp of minced garlic. Blend until smooth.

Once your noodles are cooked, drain (saving 1/4 cup pasta water) and return to the frying pan with your cooked chicken. On low heat, add your blended sauce, jarred mushrooms, and fat-free mozzarella. Stir until the cheese melts and the sauce simmers.
Make four equal portions and enjoy.

title: Chicken Pesto Pizza
ingredients: 3oz. rotisserie chicken (or your own cooked chicken breast)
61g Victoria Vegan Alfredo sauce (or homemade arugula pesto sauce)
instructions: Throw your pita in an air fryer or oven at 400 degrees for 5 minutes.
Assemble your pizza starting with 61 grams of vegan Alfredo sauce or homemade pesto arugula sauce.

Add 30g of fat-free mozzarella on top, add your 3oz. cooked chicken, 32g reduced-fat mozzarella over the top, hit it with parsley, oregano, and chili flakes, and place in the air fryer at 400 for 5–6 more minutes.
Top with aged parmesan (optional) and enjoy! Makes 4 slices.

title: Creamy Pesto Arugula Sauce
ingredients: pinch of salt and Italian seasoning
instructions: Place all the listed ingredients into a blender or food processor.
Blend, adding almond milk to thin it to your liking — a slightly thicker sauce uses about 25–30ml of almond milk.
Jar it up and refrigerate. Great on pasta, sandwiches, as a pizza sauce, or as a veggie dip. Heat it up before eating for the best results.
Refrigerate for up to 3 days, though it's usually gone within 24 hours!
macroNote: A versatile base sauce used in several other recipes in this book.

title: Bacon Jalapeno Artichoke Dip
instructions: In a blender, blend 50g of artichokes and 2–3 oz. of jalapeños until combined but still chunky (don't puree). Set aside in a separate container.

Blend your 300g of fat-free cottage cheese, 170g of nonfat Greek yogurt, 100g of fat-free mozzarella, and 60g of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese. Add a splash or two of almond milk to thin and smooth it out.
Add your seasonings and blend one more time.
Pour the contents into a baking dish.
Add 3 slices of reduced-fat provolone on top, 2 broken-up slices of precooked center-cut bacon, and a few slices of jalapeño.
Add parsley and chili flakes to the top (optional).
Place on the top rack of the oven at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, with 2 minutes of broiling at the very end.
To keep calories low, use your favorite veggies for dipping rather than chips, or toast up low-calorie bread and cut into small squares.

title: Spicy Riga"toned"
ingredients: seasonings: Italian, red garlic, paprika, garlic paste, chili flakes
instructions: Follow your pasta box directions: bring water to a boil and boil up 8 oz. of pasta.
In a bowl, mix 16oz. ground chicken with the seasonings, 1 tablespoon of each.
Pour the seasoned ground chicken into a nonstick skillet with nonstick spray at medium-high heat. Chop it into smaller pieces as it cooks, until cooked all the way through.

Make the sauce: combine 240 grams of fat-free cottage cheese, 3 Laughing Cow wedges, 56 grams of fat-free mozzarella, 1 serving of jarred pasta sauce, and another round of seasonings. Blend until smooth.
In your chicken pan, add the sauce and mix together at medium heat, bringing to a simmer.
Divide into four equal portions. Eat one now and refrigerate the rest for meal prep for the next 3 days.

title: Spicy Crispy Chicken Sandwich
instructions: Take 3 oz. of chicken breast, place in a plastic bag, and pound it down to a quarter-inch thick — the thinner, the better.
In a blender or small food processor, add 10–15 grams of corn flakes and your favorite seasonings. Blend until you have a mix of powder with some larger flakes still present.
Dip your chicken breast into 1 whisked egg mixed with 2 tablespoons of buffalo sauce.
Pour your corn flakes onto a flat plate, then roll your chicken breast in them until fully covered.
Spray your chicken with nonstick cooking spray and add salt and pepper.
Place in the air fryer and cook at 400 for 12–15 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher.
Toast your bun, add 2 tablespoons guacamole and a special sauce (2 tablespoons Dijon mustard mixed with 1 tablespoon buffalo sauce) — or whatever low-calorie sauce suits your needs.
Once your chicken patty is fully cooked, add it to your bun along with 2 slices of reduced-fat provolone.
macroNote: Multiply this recipe by however many sandwiches you'd like to make.

title: Oreo Bday Cheesecake
ingredients: 40g stevia or powdered monk fruit sugar
instructions: In a blender, add 300 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt, 115 grams of reduced-fat cream cheese, 30 to 40 grams of a zero-calorie sweetener, 1 egg, 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract, and a splash of almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Add contents to a small baking dish lined with parchment paper and a little nonstick spray.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Let it cool, then place in the freezer — the consistency is best after 2-3 hours covered in the freezer.
Make the frosting: combine 6 tbsp Cool Whip Lite, 10-15g stevia or monk fruit, 35g nonfat Greek yogurt, and 1 tbsp blended Oreo crumbs (blending them to a powder makes them go further). Mix together.
Cover the entire cheesecake with the frosting and top with a tablespoon of birthday cake sprinkles.

title: Cbums Quad Burrito
ingredients: 8oz. raw chicken breast (measured prior to cooking)
seasonings: salt, pepper, paprika, Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning
instructions: Bake an entire package of center-cut bacon in the oven on a baking dish at 400 for 20–25 minutes, until desired crispiness.
Dice up 8oz. of raw chicken breast and mix your seasonings into the chicken thoroughly.

Pour the chicken into a pan at medium-high heat with nonstick spray. Cook until the edges are golden brown and it is cooked all the way through (typically 12–15 minutes, internal temp 165°F or higher).
Warm up two large Extreme Wellness wraps in the microwave for 25 seconds.
Place both tortillas on a clean surface, overlapping one over the other.

Add 40 grams of fat-free mozzarella, 40 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt mixed with 1 tablespoon of Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning, 60 grams of chopped tomato, your cooked chicken, and 4 slices of center-cut bacon.
Roll up your burrito to the best of your ability and grill it on all sides in the pan.

title: California Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 turkey sausage pattie or 2 oz. turkey sausage (30g)
instructions: Bake frozen turkey patties on a baking sheet coated with nonstick zero-cal avocado spray, and on a separate sheet do the same with your center-cut bacon. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 minutes, taking the turkey patties out after 15 minutes.
Check your bacon at 25 minutes and broil for an additional 3–4 minutes if you want it more crispy. Make sure it's fully cooked before eating.
Air fry your 1oz. of shoestring fries at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until desired crispiness.
Measure out 50g of egg white and crack one egg into the same bowl. Mix and scramble in a nonstick pan at medium heat until finished. Salt and pepper to taste.
Assemble the burrito with the above ingredients and place back in the same pan at medium heat, giving it some light browning.

title: Costco Slice of Pizza Baby
instructions: Combine 30g self-rising flour with 40g nonfat Greek yogurt with a metal spoon, mixing until all the yogurt is absorbed into small clumps.
Flour up your hands and work all the clumps together until you can form a nice ball of dough.
Take a sheet of parchment paper, hit it with nonstick spray, and place your dough in the middle. Press down and hand-flatten until you can't get it any flatter.
Roll out your dough with a rolling pin (flouring the pin sparingly to keep calories down), rolling as evenly and thin as possible.
Once rolled out as big as possible, use a pizza cutter and shape the dough into a pizza slice triangle.
Take the additional dough and roll it into a crust, placing it over the crust edge of the slice you made.
Place in the oven on a baking sheet at 400 for 10 minutes.
Take out of the oven and add all of your toppings.
Back into the oven at 400 until the desired melt is accomplished. Enjoy.

title: Thick Boy Mcmuffins
ingredients: seasonings: sage, fennel, white pepper, oregano, salt, pepper
instructions: Combine 16 oz. of 96/4 chicken with 1 tablespoon of each seasoning listed. Mix evenly throughout the chicken.

Make five 3.2-oz. balls of seasoned chicken and smash the patties down into a large skillet at high heat, as thin as possible (you may only fit two at a time). Flip after 5 minutes and make sure the internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher before removing.
In a muffin tin, spray each opening with nonstick spray, then pour 600 grams of egg white evenly into five of the openings.
Distribute 180g reduced-fat cheddar evenly among the 5 tins.
Bake on the middle rack at 400 for 20 minutes or until cooked through (160°F in the center is safe).
On a separate baking sheet at the same temperature, bake your buns for 5 minutes, with each bun getting a slice of Velveeta.
Once everything is cooked, assemble your sandwiches. Wrap in foil and refrigerate for a couple of days at most.

title: Smash or Pass Burger
ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped jalapeños or bell pepper
instructions: Set your oven to 425 degrees and place the bacon on a baking sheet coated with nonstick spray — cook all of it at once for use in different meals throughout the week. Bake at 425 for approximately 20-25 minutes, or until desired crispiness.
Chop and sauté your onions and jalapeños with zero-calorie cooking spray in a nonstick pan at medium heat, for 5 minutes.
Split 5oz. of 93/7 beef into two separate meatballs. Season with salt and pepper.
Place on a medium-hot pan and smash both burgers flat with a spatula (or roll them out between two sheets of parchment paper with a rolling pin for extra-thin patties).
Flip after 2-3 minutes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. Check the internal temperature reaches 135°F or higher before removing.
Toast your buns in the oven for 3–5 minutes, face down on a baking sheet.
Mix all the sauce ingredients together.
Assemble your cheeseburger: bun, sauce, patty, cheese, patty, cheese, jalapeños and onions, more sauce, bun.

title: Gym Freak Pizza 2.0
ingredients: seasonings: salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, sage, paprika, garlic salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Combine 100 grams of self-rising flour and 115 grams of nonfat Greek yogurt in a bowl and stir with a spoon until all the yogurt is absorbed and it clumps up.
Lightly flour your hands and grab the clumps, forming a dough ball about the size of, or larger than, a tennis ball.
Place your dough ball on parchment paper that has been pre-sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Press down on the dough by hand until it's as flat as possible, then roll it out with a rolling pin (flouring the pin lightly if needed), as far and evenly as you can.
Make your chicken meatballs: combine all the seasonings with a full 16oz. pack of 94/6 ground chicken (1 tbsp per seasoning, going lighter on salt). Make approximately 35 small meatballs.
Cook the meatballs in your air fryer at 400 degrees for 15 minutes (usually about 20 at a time fit). Internal temperature needs to reach 165°F or higher.
Place your dough on a pizza baking sheet and bake at 425 for about 8 minutes.
Remove from the oven and assemble the rest of your toppings from the ingredient list.
Place back in the oven at 425 degrees for 10 minutes, or until the pizza reaches its desired crispiness.

title: Crispy Buffalo Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 16 oz. thin chicken breasts, sliced into 7 tenders
salt, pepper, baking soda, baking powder, 1 tsp garlic salt
protein cheese: 1 scoop meal booster cheese
cayenne pepper, salt, pepper, almond milk
instructions: Slice 16oz. of chicken breast into 7 equal-sized tenders.
Tenderize each slice: place on a cutting board, cover with saran wrap, and hammer down until 1/2 inch thick.
Make your dipping stations: in bowl 1, combine 30g of self-rising flour with the seasonings (a teaspoon of each).
Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and whisk with 1 to 2 tablespoons of pickle juice.
Take one slice at a time: dip into the egg wash, drop into the flour, then coat evenly with your dry hand. Repeat for each breast.
Generously hit the breasts with 0-cal olive oil spray and place in the air fryer.

Cook at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, flipping at the 6-minute mark and spraying again with olive oil. Add more time for desired crispiness, checking that internal temperature is above 165 before removing.
Hit the tenders with 0-cal Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce, covering them completely, then place back in the air fryer for 2 minutes.

title: Crispy Chicken Sandwich (Makes 7)
instructions: In a bowl, measure out 15 oz. of 96/4 ground chicken and add all the seasonings to the chicken.
In a separate bowl, whisk one egg, and in an additional bowl, measure out 35g of flour.
Make 7 patties of equal size, approximately 2.2oz. per patty. Place in the freezer, covered, for 2 hours.
Remove your patties from the freezer, dip into the whisked egg, then into the flour, fully coating each.
Hit the patties with salt, pepper, and olive oil spray before placing them in the air fryer.
Air fry at 400 for 15 minutes, flipping at the 7-minute mark and spraying again with olive oil. Continue for an additional 8 minutes (cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher).
Toast all 7 buns in the oven at 400 for 4-5 minutes.
Chop up your romaine lettuce.
Assemble your sandwiches: light mayo, patty, lettuce, more light mayo, and the top bun.

title: Chicken McShreddies
ingredients: seasonings: 1 tbsp cayenne pepper, 2 tbsp salt, 1/2 tbsp pepper, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp garlic paste
instructions: Place 16 oz. of 96/4 ground chicken into a bowl and add all the seasonings, mixing them in throughout (gloves recommended).
Whisk together 2 eggs with some pickle juice in a separate bowl.
Add 40 grams of self-rising flour into another bowl, with the same seasonings whisked in.
Take your ground chicken and make 24 equally sized nuggets (optional: cover with saran wrap and freeze for 2 hours for easier handling).
Dunk each nugget in your egg wash, then dip into the flour — use your right hand for the egg wash and keep your left hand dry for the flour, fully coating before removing.
Repeat until all 24 nuggets are ready for the fryer. Add salt and pepper to the tops, plus 0-cal olive oil spray.
Air fry at 400 degrees for 15 minutes (cook 12 at a time unless you have a large fryer).
Make sure the internal temperature reaches 165 before serving.
Serve with low-calorie ketchup, ranch, or BBQ sauce.

title: Crispy Tinga Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 4 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped
instructions: In a slow cooker, spray the bottom with 0-cal olive oil spray and add 16 ounces of chicken breast. Add 180 grams of no-sugar-added tomato sauce, 4 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (blended or chopped), a tablespoon of each seasoning, and 1/2 a chopped white onion.
Slow cook at low to medium heat for 4-6 hours (time varies by slow cooker). Make sure the internal temperature reaches 165 before shredding.
Once fully cooked, shred your chicken with two forks.

This makes four tacos: take a nonstick pan sprayed with olive oil, heat to medium, and place a large low-calorie tortilla in the pan. Add 30g of reduced-fat cheese as well as your chicken. Fold into a taco and cook on both sides until golden brown.
If you have additional calories, dip them into chipotle protein sauce, ranch, or guacamole.
macroNote: Macros listed are for a single serving/taco.

title: The Perfect Steak Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook up 3oz. of flank steak at medium heat in a nonstick pan, seasoned with salt and pepper. Cook each side until internal temperature reaches a minimum of 135°F.
Dice up your steak into small cubes, or pulse in a food processor until more like shredded steak.
In that same pan, spray with olive oil nonstick spray and add 20g of frozen diced potato. Add 3 tbsp water and put a lid on the pan for 10–12 minutes, cooking the potatoes to desired crispiness.
Leave the potatoes in the pan and reduce heat to low-medium. Add your two whisked eggs, your steak, 28g of reduced-fat cheddar, and 1 slice of Velveeta, cooking it all down together.
Get a large Wellness Extreme Wrap or any large low-calorie tortilla and add your steak/egg filling.
Roll into a burrito and place back in the pan, browning each side before slicing and enjoying.
Add hot sauce, or for extra protein, dip it into some nonfat Greek yogurt.

title: Pollo Asado Tacos
ingredients: 6 Xtreme Wellness taco wraps (30 cal each)
cilantro lime crema: 100g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine all of the seasonings: 2 tbsp achiote paste, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp orange juice, salt and pepper, and 20g chopped chipotle pepper.
Add two chicken breasts (16oz. worth) to the bowl of seasonings. Hand mix the seasonings and juices, thoroughly coating your chicken.
Add a pinch of baking powder over the top of your chicken for extra crispiness before placing in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.
Once your chicken has reached an internal temp of 165°F or higher, remove, place on a cutting board, and cube to your desired size.
Make a simple sauce: take 100g nonfat Greek yogurt, 4 tbsp cilantro, 1 tbsp lime juice, salt and pepper, and blend together.
Get 6 low-cal taco tortillas (40 cal or less) and equally distribute your pollo asado and sauce. Cube 1/2 an avocado and distribute evenly over the top.
Optional: add white onion, lettuce, and your favorite low-cal cheese to top (adjust macros if using this option).

title: Shredded Grinder
instructions: Take your largest cutting board and add a cup and a half of shredded lettuce.
Place 3.6 oz. deli turkey breast over the lettuce, followed by peppers from a jar and a few dill pickles.
Add 2 slices of tomato, salt and pepper the tomato, and add 1 slice of low-cal cheese.
Optional: add a tbsp of pickled onions (jarred) and 28g of turkey pepperoni.
Top with 15g of mayo and mustard to taste. Add 2 tbsp red wine vinegar.
Chop up all of your ingredients and combine.
To lower calories, roll up your ingredients into a low-cal wrap. Or use a hoagie roll — find one under 200 calories, adjusting macros if you go over.

title: Barbacoa Quesadilla
instructions: Get some Del Real Foods Barbacoa (found at most grocery stores). Follow the box directions and heat up your meat.
While it's cooking in a pan on medium heat, add 15g chopped chipotle peppers for some spice as well as 1 tbsp of tomato paste, mixing thoroughly.
Once your barbacoa is fully cooked, add 8oz. (drained) barbacoa to the largest, lowest-calorie tortilla you can find (a large Extreme Wellness wrap at 80 cal works well).
Add 56g of reduced fat mozzarella and chopped cilantro (white onions optional).
Fold over like a massive taco and add one slice of low-cal cheese over the top. Garnish with another sprinkle of cilantro.
Place in the oven and broil for 2 minutes or until all the cheese is melted.
Plate and enjoy — for bonus protein, add some nonfat Greek yogurt on the side.

title: Big Mac Smash Burger
instructions: Split 5oz. of 93/7 beef into two 2.5 oz. patties. Roll into balls and add salt and pepper (a gourmet burger seasoning works well too).
Get a frying pan up to medium heat, hit it with nonstick spray.
Add your two meatballs to the pan and carefully press each one flat with a spatula.
Cook for 2-3 minutes before flipping. Cook until internal temp reaches 135°F or higher, then give each patty a slice of reduced fat cheddar until melted.
In the same pan, add the top and bottom buns face down at medium heat and toast (about 2 minutes).
Make your sauce: combine 1 tbsp light mayo, 1 tbsp low-cal ketchup, 1 tbsp mustard, and diced onions. Add a pinch of white vinegar if you have it, and stir.
Add the sauce and patties to your buns as well as some shredded lettuce. Enjoy!
macroNote: Macros are printed identically to the Barbacoa Quesadilla in the source book — likely a duplication error in the original text, kept as-is for fidelity.

title: Creamy Chicken Fajita Burrito
ingredients: 4 large Ole Extreme Wellness wraps (low-cal wrap)
seasonings: onion powder, garlic, chipotle, taco seasoning, salt, pepper
instructions: Place 1.5lbs of chicken breast on a cutting board and chop into thin, 1-inch-thick slices. Place in a bowl and mix in seasonings.
Chop your white onion and bell peppers (cut in strips) on a separate cutting board — wash hands when switching from raw meat to veggies.
Add all the seasonings into your chicken bowl, along with the chopped veggies, and mix together.
In the same bowl, add 30g tomato paste and 30g of chopped or blended chipotles in adobo powder, mixing thoroughly through the veggies and chicken.
Place your fajita chicken and veggies on a baking sheet after spraying with nonstick olive oil or avocado spray.
Bake in the oven at 400 degrees for approximately 20 minutes. Check with a meat thermometer that the chicken has an internal temp of 165°F or higher before removing.

Make the cheese sauce by blending 160g nonfat Greek yogurt, a splash of almond milk, 15g chipotles in adobo, salt and pepper, and 1 scoop of cheesy meal booster (or cheese powder from a mac and cheese box).
Once blended, add cooked chicken and veggies to a clean mixing bowl and add your cheese sauce, plus 112g reduced fat cheddar.
Equally distribute the cheesy fajita mix into 4 low-calorie tortillas. Roll them up and fry on both sides in a frying pan to desired crispiness.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Divide 18oz. of chicken into three equal portions.
Place your chicken into a zip lock bag and use a kitchen mallet to beat it until it is 1 inch thick and even.
Get two bowls: whisk two eggs into one, and add 120g Italian bread crumbs into the other.
Dip your chicken into the whisked egg, then place in the bread crumbs, fully covering it with your dry hand. Repeat for each breast.
Hit them with salt and pepper and olive oil spray before placing in the air fryer.
Cook at 400 degrees for approximately 20 minutes, flipping at 10 minutes. Check with a thermometer that you're above 165 before removing.
Place a slice of low-cal mozzarella on each breast, place on a baking sheet, and broil for 2 minutes.
In a blender, combine 20g parmesan, 60g fat free cottage cheese, 2 tbsp basil paste, 1 cup basil leaves, 1 tbsp garlic paste, salt and pepper, and a splash of lemon.
On toasted buns, add your chicken breast, 35g marinara, and 1/3 of the pesto sauce.

title: Creamy Pizza Protein Burritos
instructions: Warm up a medium-sized pan to high heat. Hit the pan with avocado spray and place 10oz. of 96/4 beef into the pan.
Season the beef with salt, pepper, garlic, and Italian seasoning (approximately a tsp of each, adjusting to preference).
Cook the beef until no pink is left and place it in a separate bowl for later.
On a cutting board, chop up 60g of turkey pepperoni as well as 9 slices of Canadian bacon (or lean ham if you have it).
Place your turkey pepperoni and Canadian bacon back into the same nonstick pan at medium-high heat just to crisp up the edges (2-3 minutes, stirring).

Add your beef back to the pan and reduce heat to medium-low. Add 120g of cheese, 62g of 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese, more of the previous seasonings, and 1 cup of lower-calorie pizza sauce. Stir until the cheese and cream cheese melt together.
Evenly distribute the pizza filling into 7 low-calorie tortillas.
Freeze them or refrigerate for 2-3 days.

title: Spicy Mcbuffins
ingredients: 12.5 oz. ground turkey or turkey sausage
instructions: Make 5, 2.5 oz. turkey sausage patties. Add salt, pepper, garlic, and your favorite herbs to each.
On high heat in a nonstick pan (with 0-cal cooking spray), cook the turkey patties for approximately 6 minutes on each side. Make sure internal temp reaches 165°F or higher before removing.
In a nonstick muffin tin sprayed with nonstick spray, distribute 300g of egg white into 5 empty spaces.
Evenly distribute 50g worth of reduced fat cheddar over the egg whites.
Hit the egg whites with salt and pepper and bake at 400 degrees for approximately 15 minutes.
Add 5 Franz keto buns, halved, into the oven at 400 for 5 minutes just for a slight toast.
Assemble: bun, Velveeta slice, egg patty, turkey patty, 2 tbsp of a low-calorie store-bought nacho cheese (35 cal), and jalapeños. Top with the other bun.
Cover and refrigerate for 2-3 days and enjoy.

title: Mrs. Shreds Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Set your oven to 425 and place 5 slices of center cut bacon onto a baking dish. Bake for approximately 25 minutes on the top rack, or until desired crispiness.
Get a pan to medium heat and add 1 tbsp of olive oil or zero-cal cooking spray.
Add 3 cups of Simply Potato hash browns (cut this in half if you don't need the extra calories).
Cook for 6-7 minutes on each side until golden brown, then set aside.
Whisk 3 eggs and 300g of egg white and place into the same pan at medium heat. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook for approximately 7-8 minutes until cooked thoroughly.

Add 12 oz. cubed ham (sautéed ahead of time if you like), 60g reduced fat cheddar, and your five slices of bacon. Add your cooked hash browns and mix together at medium heat. Add mushrooms (optional — sauté while the bacon cooks).
Evenly distribute your pan into 3 equal containers.
Once ready to eat, add 40g nonfat Greek yogurt, hot sauce, and a tbsp of guacamole for extra flavor!

title: Chicken Al Pastor Mac N Cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees once the meat is marinated and ready to cook.
Bring about 3 cups of water to a boil and cook your protein pasta (8oz.) for 7-8 minutes.
Make your al pastor marinade: place 50ml of orange juice with all of the herbs and spices (increase from a tsp to a tbsp if you like more flavor). Blend until smooth.
Place 3 small chicken breasts (15oz. total) into a zip lock bag with your al pastor marinade. Add chopped pineapple if desired. Marinate for 1-2 hrs or overnight in the refrigerator.
Place chicken on a baking sheet and bake at 400 for 22 minutes. Make sure internal temp is 165°F or higher. (Optional: sear both sides in a hot pan before baking.)
Once cooked, chop your chicken into cubes on a cutting board.

In a blender, make your mac sauce: blend 1/2 Banza cheese packet, 400g fat free cottage cheese, 40ml fat free evaporated milk, and 1 scoop cheesy meal booster with salt and pepper, until completely smooth.
Add your chicken, noodles, and cheese sauce into one bowl and mix all ingredients together.
Top off with cilantro and white onion and distribute evenly into 3 servings. Feel free to double this recipe for 6 servings.

title: Quatro BLT Burger
instructions: Make an optional but super necessary protein ranch (or just use simple mayo). For the ranch: blend 100g nonfat Greek yogurt, 3 tbsp chives, 2 tbsp green onions, 3 tbsp Hidden Valley ranch mix, 3 peeled garlic cloves, and about 40ml evaporated fat free milk.
Set your oven to 425 and cook your center cut bacon for 28 minutes, flipping at about 14 minutes, until desired crispiness.
Slice your tomato thick and chop up your lettuce.
Divide 12.5 oz. of 96/4 beef into 5 equal patties. Place on parchment paper, roll into balls, and season well with salt, pepper, and a gourmet burger seasoning (Kinder's works well).
Flatten as thin as you can get them on another sheet of parchment paper before cooking in a pan at high heat, 2-3 minutes on each side (internal temp needs to reach a minimum of 135°F).
Toast your buns in the oven or pan (oven at 425 for 2-3 minutes).
Assemble your BLT burgers: bun, sauce, 4 slices of center cut bacon, tomato, patty, cheese slice, lettuce, sauce, bun.

title: Lean BLT
ingredients: 8 slices Hemplers zero sugar center cut bacon
chipotle sauce (see book recipe): nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Bake your center cut bacon at 425 for 28 minutes, flipping at 14 minutes, until desired crispiness.
Cut your tomatoes and lettuce.
Toast your bread or buns of choice.
Assemble: light mayo on each slice of bread, 8 slices of bacon, tomato, lettuce.
Sometimes you just gotta keep it simple, friends.

title: Shred Lab Fiesta Salad
ingredients: chipotle garlic ranch: 259g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Make the dressing first: place all the chipotle garlic ranch ingredients in a food processor and blend until completely smooth. Store in a sauce bottle or tupperware for up to 5 days.

Chop some white onion and sauté at medium heat over the stove in a nonstick pan with nonstick spray. Once cooked, add your 7.5 oz. of 96/4 beef. Toss in the taco seasoning of your choice, salt and pepper to taste. Chop the meat into small, ground beef-sized pieces until no pink remains and remove from heat.

In a bowl, add your beef, then your chopped salad, diced tomato, more white onion, 28g reduced fat cheese, 30g guacamole, then your dressing (use approximately 40-50g of dressing to match the macros).

title: Deviled Egg Salmon Wrap
ingredients: 2 pouches Chicken of the Sea Wild Caught Smoked Salmon
instructions: Boil 2 eggs (or more depending on how many you're making).
Once boiled, peel the eggs and discard the shells.
In a mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients and mash together with a fork, finishing with a hit of paprika and a dash of salt and pepper.
Split your deviled egg smoked salmon onto two low-cal tortillas. Add a slice of pepper jack and about 30g of avocado if desired.
Once rolled up like a burrito, throw it back in a frying pan with nonstick spray and cook at medium heat until all sides are browned.
Keep it simple and take these to go.

title: Bacon Garlic Steak Fries
ingredients: creamy garlic ranch: 150g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Take tasty shreds outside and go grill. Throw your seasoned top sirloin on the grill at medium-high heat. Cook time depends on the thickness of the cut — use a meat thermometer, aiming for 130-135°F internal temp before removing.
In an air fryer, toss about half a bag of shoestring French fries in. Set to 400, season however you'd like, and cook for 15 minutes.
Measure out 4 oz. of shoestring French fries into a bowl. Add some chopped fresh garlic and chives.
Have some cooked center cut bacon on hand to add a chopped slice to your bowl — highly recommended.
Add your 6 oz. of top sirloin, diced into small cubes.
Place about 50g of your creamy garlic ranch (blend all ranch ingredients in a food processor until smooth) over the top and enjoy.

title: Pizza Tacos
ingredients: seasonings: Italian, garlic, salt, pepper, sage, lemon pepper
instructions: Cube 6oz. of raw chicken and add to a bowl with a tsp of Italian, garlic, salt and pepper, sage, and lemon pepper, and mix.
Add your chicken to a nonstick pan with nonstick spray at high heat. Cook until completely cooked through, chopping into smaller pieces to make sure it's fully cooked.
Add 20g pizza sauce, 15g reduced fat cheese, 30g Canadian bacon, and 5g turkey pepperoni to each of your 3 pitas.
Bake at 400 for 5 minutes.
Top with powdered parmesan and chili flakes if you'd like.

title: Gym Freak 3.0 (One Big Pizza)
instructions: Make the dough: mix 130g nonfat Greek yogurt and 100g self rising flour into a large mixing bowl with a spoon until it becomes flaky and dry.
Flour your hands and ball up the dough by compressing it together.
Once you have your dough ball, set the oven to 425.
Place the dough ball on parchment paper hit with nonstick spray to keep it from sticking.
Drizzle flour on your rolling pin and roll out to the largest possible size — circle or square, your choice.
Hit it with salt, pepper, and oregano and place in the oven for 10 minutes at 425.
While it's baking, cook up 3 oz. of low fat beef with oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper, chopping and cooking until no pink remains.
Remove your pizza dough before it burns, and top with all the toppings, starting with pizza sauce first.
Put it back in the oven at 425 for 5 minutes or until desired cheese melt.
Cut in half — eat half now, save the other half for later (or eat it all at once).

title: Creamy Enchilada Burrito Dippers
ingredients: Rotel diced tomato and green chiles (can)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Spray a baking sheet with olive oil or avocado spray.
Add 16oz. of chicken breast and season with the seasonings.
Bake at 400 for 22 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher.
In a separate bowl, shred your chicken using two forks. (Alternatively, slow cook the chicken breast with seasonings for 6 hours for a more hands-off approach.)
Heat a nonstick pan to medium, sprayed with oil, and add your shredded chicken. Crisp up the edges for 2-3 minutes.

Add 1/2 cup of low-fat beans, 30g reduced fat cream cheese, 50g reduced fat cheddar, 5 tbsp of canned diced tomatoes/green chiles, and cilantro. Stir until the cheeses melt and combine with the chicken.
Dish the enchilada mix into a bowl and measure the total grams. Divide by 6 for the amount to add to each tortilla.
Add to 6 tortillas, roll them up, and place on a baking sheet. Add 50g reduced fat cheddar over the top, more cilantro, and bake at 350 for 5 minutes.
Serve with enchilada sauce for dipping.

title: Creamy Buffalo Pizza Dippers
instructions: Pre-prep 12oz. of chicken breast any way you like — grilling outdoors with salt, pepper, and paprika works well. Make sure your chicken reaches 165°F internally before chopping.

Put a pan on medium heat, hit it with nonstick spray, and add your precooked chicken cubed, 60g turkey pepperoni, 1/2 to 1 cup of Frank's Red Hot Buffalo sauce, 70g of reduced fat cream cheese, and 120g reduced fat cheddar.
Add a quarter cup of water and cover your pan with a lid for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese and cream cheese begin to melt.
Stir in some chives and your favorite seasonings to taste.
Place into a bowl and measure the weight on a digital food scale.
Evenly disperse your pizza filling onto 6 tortillas, roll them up, and enjoy.
Refrigerate for 1-2 days and then freeze if you haven't consumed them.

title: Buffalo Chicken Bacon Bagels
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Place 8 slices of center cut bacon on a baking dish with nonstick spray (avocado spray).
Bake your bacon for 25 minutes, flipping at 12 minutes, until it reaches desired crispiness.
Toast 4 Royo brand bagels or whatever lower-cal bagels you can find (low-calorie toasted bread also works).
In one pan, combine pre-grilled chicken (11oz.) chopped, 60g reduced fat cheddar, 58g low-cal cream cheese, and 1/2 cup Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce.
Cook at medium heat, stirring often, until combined and simmering.
Add chives and evenly dish out into 4 bagels or sandwiches, with 2 slices of bacon per sandwich and a thin slice of provolone (40 cal per slice).
Refrigerate for 2-3 days in sealed tupperware. Microwave for 30-40 seconds then air fry at 375 for 1 minute the next day.

title: Steak & Cheese Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: hot sauce, pico de gallo, cilantro (optional)
instructions: Season 8oz. of sirloin tip with salt, pepper, taco seasoning, and garlic seasoning.
Cook your sirloin in a nonstick pan with avocado spray on medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side (depending on thickness), until internal temp reaches 140°F or higher.
On a cutting board, dice your steak into quarter-sized cubes and toss into a bowl.
Whisk together 10 eggs and scramble in a nonstick pan with avocado spray — about 10 minutes with occasional stirring.
Once cooked, add your eggs to the bowl with your steak.
Add 80g reduced fat cheddar and 6 tbsp of nacho cheese to that bowl.
Optional: add cilantro and hot sauce for extra flavor.
Stir all your ingredients and equally distribute the taco filling into 6 taco tortillas (45-calorie Mission brand works well).
Fry on both sides in a pan at medium heat until the tortilla gets golden brown.
Refrigerate and reheat for 2-3 days, or enjoy fresh.

title: Garlic Steak Alfredo Mac
ingredients: seasonings: salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic, steak seasoning
instructions: Boil 2-3 cups of water; once boiling, add 8oz. of Banza protein macaroni pasta and cook for 5-7 minutes.
Chop 6 cloves of garlic, a handful of chives, and dice up 1/2 a white onion.
Cube 24oz. of your top round steak, add to a bowl, and season with a tbsp of salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic, and steak seasoning.

Get a pan to medium heat, hit it with avocado spray, and cook your top round until the edges are browned and internal temp is 135°F or higher. Add chives and half your chopped garlic, cooking until combined with the steak.
Place your steak in a separate dish.
In the same pan at medium heat, add avocado spray, toss in your white onions and the rest of your garlic, and sauté 2-3 minutes.
Add 200ml of fat free Fairlife, 100g reduced fat cream cheese, and 60g fat free mozzarella, cooking until it reaches a simmer while stirring.
Once melted together, add 1/2 cup of pasta water and stir.
Dish your pasta, steak, and sauce into 4 equal servings and top with a little parmesan, salt, and pepper.

title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Burrito
instructions: Season 17 oz. of chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite taco seasoning.
Cook your chicken on high heat in a nonstick pan (avocado spray) until internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher. Dice and place in a large mixing bowl.
In the same pan, pan-fry 5 slices of center cut bacon, chop, and add to the bowl.

Make the sauce: in a food processor combine 150g nonfat Greek yogurt, tsp onion powder, tbsp ranch, 20g chipotle adobo pepper, a splash of lime juice, 4 garlic cloves, cilantro, and a dash of salt and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add your sauce to the mixing bowl with the chicken and bacon.
Add 80g reduced fat cheddar and mix all the ingredients together.
Dish out 5 equal portions of burrito filling onto 5 tortillas and enjoy.
Refrigerate and reheat for 2-3 days before discarding.

title: Chick N Out Burger
ingredients: 4 Oro Wheat keto buns (80 cal or less)
instructions: Make the In-N-Out fakeaway sauce: combine 60g light mayo, 2 tbsp relish, 20g light ketchup, 15g mustard, paprika, and a splash of white vinegar. Mix with a spoon.
Cover your chicken with plastic wrap and use a mallet (or a knife) to thin it out to no more than an inch thick, then slice into 4 equal portions.
Whisk 2 eggs in a bowl with a splash of pickle juice. In a separate station, add 80g of corn flakes plus your seasonings and a tsp of baking powder, mixing together.
With your wet hand, dip chicken into the egg wash, then set onto the corn flakes. With your dry hand, flip until fully coated. Repeat for all four.
Hit your coated breasts with salt and pepper and air fry at 400 degrees for 22-25 minutes (internal temp needs to hit 165°F or higher).
Toast your buns and assemble: bun, sauce, tomato, lettuce, patty, cheese, onion, sauce, bun.

title: Ham Breakfast Hot Pockets
instructions: Cube 10 oz. of lean ham and cook in a pan at medium heat with avocado spray until the edges brown. Set aside.
Dice all veggies and sauté in a pan at medium heat with avocado spray.
Whisk together 11 eggs, then make 5 equal-sized flat omelets.
Place each omelet in a tortilla with 35g reduced fat cheddar, 2 tbsp of nacho cheese, and an equal portion of ham and sautéed veggies.
Roll them up and fry in a pan until the edges are golden brown.

title: One Pan Protein Nachos
instructions: In a bowl, add 16 oz. of 96/4 raw beef. Add salt, pepper, 2 tbsp taco seasoning, and 2 tbsp chile lime seasoning. Hand mix the seasonings thoroughly.
Take a large pan, hit it with nonstick cooking spray, and heat for 2 minutes at medium heat.
Add your beef and cook for 5-6 minutes, chopping into small pieces. Once no longer pink, add the other ingredients.
Add 50g reduced fat cheddar, green chiles, diced tomato (canned), and 1/2 cup low-fat refried beans. Stir for 5-6 minutes until the cheese and beans combine with the beef.
Dish into three servings — add nonfat Greek yogurt as a sour cream substitute and use a low-calorie chip (Quest chips, nacho or loaded taco flavor).

title: Pepper "Jacked" Chicken Bacon Burritos

Cook for 5-6 minutes on high heat and flip for another 5-6 minutes, making sure the chicken is cooked through.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Add 14 slices of center cut bacon to a baking sheet and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until desired crispiness.
Once your bacon is cooked, chop into small squares and add to a bowl with the cooked chicken, 200g reduced fat cheddar, 200g reduced fat mozzarella, and 4-5 tbsp canned green chiles. Mix together.
Equally distribute the burrito filling onto 8 low-calorie tortillas, roll them up, and bake on a baking sheet at 400 for 10 minutes.
Let cool, wrap in tin foil, and either freeze or refrigerate for 2-3 days.

title: Bang Bang Chicken Bites

Measure 50g crushed corn flakes into a bowl, and in a separate bowl, crack and whisk 2 eggs.
Dice 16oz. chicken breast into small cubes.
With one hand, dip your chicken into the egg wash, letting the excess drip back into the bowl.
Drop the chicken cubes into your crushed corn flakes and fully coat with your dry hand (or a spoon). Repeat until all chicken is coated.
Hit your coated chicken with salt, pepper, and avocado oil spray.
Air fry for 20 minutes at 400 degrees, shaking at 10 minutes, continuing until cooked through at 165°F.
Make the bang bang sauce by combining 100g light mayo, 2 tbsp Frank's Red Hot Sweet Chili, 2-3 tbsp sriracha, lemon juice, and chili flakes.

title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Fries
ingredients: seasonings: garlic salt, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder

Air fry at 400 for 20 minutes (flip at 10 minutes), until the chicken reaches 165°F or higher internal temperature.
Dip the tenders in Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce and place back in the air fryer at 400 for 1-2 minutes.

Assemble your wraps: tortilla, tomato, lettuce, chicken strip, and a drizzle of protein ranch or light mayo.

title: In N Out Style Grilled Cheese
ingredients: copy cat burger sauce: 4 tbsp light mayo
instructions: Chop your favorite burger veggies — romaine lettuce, tomato, and white onions work well.
Make your burger sauce: mix together all the Copy Cat burger sauce ingredients.
Get 24oz. raw 96/4 beef and separate into 8, 3oz. balls. Roll in your favorite seasonings, then flatten into half-inch thick patties on parchment paper.
On a grill or your favorite nonstick pan, cook these burgers at medium-high heat until they reach 135°F or higher.
